/**
 * date-picker.js
 *
 * Attaches a calendar popup to a text input. The popup is a dialog that
 * contains a grid of day buttons. Focus moves into the grid when it opens and
 * returns to the input when it closes.
 *
 * Keyboard support inside the grid:
 *   Arrow keys      move by one day or one week
 *   Home / End      move to the start or end of the current week
 *   PageUp/PageDown move to the previous or next month
 *   Enter / Space   choose the focused day
 *   Escape          close without choosing
 */

const DAYS_PER_WEEK = 7;
const WEEKS_SHOWN = 6;
const DAY_NAMES = ['Sunday', 'Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday'];

/** Return a new Date moved by `count` days (negative values move backward). */
function addDays(date, count) {
  const copy = new Date(date.getTime());
  copy.setDate(copy.getDate() + count);
  return copy;
}

/** Return a new Date moved by `count` months, staying on the first of the month. */
function addMonths(date, count) {
  return new Date(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth() + count, 1);
}

function isSameDay(a, b) {
  return a.getFullYear() === b.getFullYear() &&
    a.getMonth() === b.getMonth() &&
    a.getDate() === b.getDate();
}

/** Format a date as YYYY-MM-DD, the value format used by the input. */
function toIsoDate(date) {
  const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${date.getFullYear()}-${month}-${day}`;
}

export class DatePicker {
  /**
   * @param {HTMLInputElement} input  The field that receives the chosen date.
   * @param {Object} [options]
   * @param {Date} [options.min]      Earliest selectable date.
   * @param {Date} [options.max]      Latest selectable date.
   * @param {string} [options.locale] BCP 47 tag used for month and day labels.
   */
  constructor(input, options = {}) {
    this.input = input;
    this.min = options.min || null;
    this.max = options.max || null;
    this.locale = options.locale || 'en-US';
    this.focused = new Date();
    this.selected = null;
    this.dialog = this.buildDialog();
    this.input.setAttribute('aria-haspopup', 'dialog');
    this.input.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
      if (event.key === 'ArrowDown' && event.altKey) this.open();
    });
  }

  buildDialog() {
    const dialog = document.createElement('div');
    dialog.setAttribute('role', 'dialog');
    dialog.setAttribute('aria-modal', 'true');
    dialog.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Choose date');
    dialog.hidden = true;
    dialog.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => this.onKeyDown(event));
    this.input.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', dialog);
    return dialog;
  }

  open() {
    const parsed = new Date(this.input.value);
    this.focused = Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()) ? new Date() : parsed;
    this.dialog.hidden = false;
    this.render();
  }

  close() {
    this.dialog.hidden = true;
    this.input.focus();
  }

  isDisabled(date) {
    return Boolean((this.min && date < this.min) || (this.max && date > this.max));
  }

  /** Rebuild the grid for the month that contains this.focused. */
  render() {
    const monthLabel = this.focused.toLocaleDateString(this.locale, { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
    const grid = document.createElement('table');
    grid.setAttribute('role', 'grid');
    grid.setAttribute('aria-label', monthLabel);

    // Begin on the Sunday on or before the first of the month.
    const first = new Date(this.focused.getFullYear(), this.focused.getMonth(), 1);
    let cursor = addDays(first, -first.getDay());

    for (let week = 0; week < WEEKS_SHOWN; week += 1) {
      const row = grid.insertRow();
      for (let col = 0; col < DAYS_PER_WEEK; col += 1) {
        row.appendChild(this.buildCell(cursor));
        cursor = addDays(cursor, 1);
      }
    }
    this.dialog.replaceChildren(grid);
    const target = grid.querySelector('button[tabindex="0"]');
    if (target) target.focus();
  }

  buildCell(date) {
    const cell = document.createElement('td');
    cell.setAttribute('role', 'gridcell');
    const button = document.createElement('button');
    button.type = 'button';
    button.textContent = String(date.getDate());
    button.setAttribute('aria-label', `${DAY_NAMES[date.getDay()]}, ${toIsoDate(date)}`);
    button.tabIndex = isSameDay(date, this.focused) ? 0 : -1;
    button.disabled = this.isDisabled(date);
    if (this.selected && isSameDay(date, this.selected)) {
      button.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
    }
    button.addEventListener('click', () => this.choose(date));
    cell.appendChild(button);
    return cell;
  }

  choose(date) {
    this.selected = date;
    this.input.value = toIsoDate(date);
    this.input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
    this.close();
  }

  onKeyDown(event) {
    const moves = {
      ArrowLeft: () => addDays(this.focused, -1),
      ArrowRight: () => addDays(this.focused, 1),
      ArrowUp: () => addDays(this.focused, -DAYS_PER_WEEK),
      ArrowDown: () => addDays(this.focused, DAYS_PER_WEEK),
      Home: () => addDays(this.focused, -this.focused.getDay()),
      End: () => addDays(this.focused, DAYS_PER_WEEK - this.focused.getDay() - 1),
      PageUp: () => addMonths(this.focused, -1),
      PageDown: () => addMonths(this.focused, 1),
    };
    if (event.key === 'Escape') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.close();
    } else if (moves[event.key]) {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.focused = moves[event.key]();
      this.render();
    }
  }
}

# time-picker.js — Time selection component with keyboard support

```js
/**
 * time-picker.js
 *
 * A time selection component built from two spinbutton fields (hours and
 * minutes). Each field follows the ARIA spinbutton pattern, so screen readers
 * announce the current value, and the whole control can be operated from the
 * keyboard without a pointer.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   const picker = new TimePicker(document.querySelector('#start-time'), {
 *     hour: 9,
 *     minute: 30,
 *     minuteStep: 5,
 *     label: 'Start time',
 *   });
 *   picker.root.addEventListener('timechange', (e) => console.log(e.detail));
 */

const HOUR_MIN = 0;
const HOUR_MAX = 23;
const MINUTE_MIN = 0;
const MINUTE_MAX = 59;

const DEFAULTS = {
  hour: 0,
  minute: 0,
  minuteStep: 1,   // amount applied by ArrowUp / ArrowDown on the minute field
  pageStep: 10,    // amount applied by PageUp / PageDown on either field
  label: 'Time',
};

/** Return the value as a two-digit string, e.g. 7 becomes "07". */
function pad(value) {
  return String(value).padStart(2, '0');
}

/** Restrict a number to the inclusive range [min, max]. */
function clamp(value, min, max) {
  if (value < min) return min;
  if (value > max) return max;
  return value;
}

/**
 * Move a value by a signed amount. When the result leaves the range it wraps
 * to the opposite end, so repeated ArrowUp on 23 hours returns to 0.
 */
function stepWithWrap(value, delta, min, max) {
  const next = value + delta;
  if (next > max) return min;
  if (next < min) return max;
  return next;
}

export class TimePicker {
  /**
   * @param {HTMLElement} root     Container that receives the picker markup.
   * @param {object}      options  Overrides for DEFAULTS.
   */
  constructor(root, options = {}) {
    this.root = root;
    this.options = { ...DEFAULTS, ...options };
    this.hour = clamp(this.options.hour, HOUR_MIN, HOUR_MAX);
    this.minute = clamp(this.options.minute, MINUTE_MIN, MINUTE_MAX);
    this.pending = ''; // digits typed since the field gained focus

    this.hourField = this.createField('Hours', HOUR_MIN, HOUR_MAX);
    this.minuteField = this.createField('Minutes', MINUTE_MIN, MINUTE_MAX);

    this.root.setAttribute('role', 'group');
    this.root.setAttribute('aria-label', this.options.label);
    this.root.append(this.hourField, this.createSeparator(), this.minuteField);
    this.render();
  }

  /** Build one spinbutton element with its ARIA range attributes. */
  createField(name, min, max) {
    const field = document.createElement('span');
    field.className = 'time-picker__field';
    field.tabIndex = 0;
    field.setAttribute('role', 'spinbutton');
    field.setAttribute('aria-label', name);
    field.setAttribute('aria-valuemin', String(min));
    field.setAttribute('aria-valuemax', String(max));
    field.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => this.onKeyDown(e, field));
    field.addEventListener('focus', () => { this.pending = ''; });
    return field;
  }

  createSeparator() {
    const sep = document.createElement('span');
    sep.className = 'time-picker__separator';
    sep.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    sep.textContent = ':';
    return sep;
  }

  /** Dispatch a key press to the appropriate adjustment. */
  onKeyDown(event, field) {
    const isHour = field === this.hourField;
    const min = isHour ? HOUR_MIN : MINUTE_MIN;
    const max = isHour ? HOUR_MAX : MINUTE_MAX;
    const small = isHour ? 1 : this.options.minuteStep;
    const current = isHour ? this.hour : this.minute;
    let next = null;

    switch (event.key) {
      case 'ArrowUp':   next = stepWithWrap(current, small, min, max); break;
      case 'ArrowDown': next = stepWithWrap(current, -small, min, max); break;
      case 'PageUp':    next = stepWithWrap(current, this.options.pageStep, min, max); break;
      case 'PageDown':  next = stepWithWrap(current, -this.options.pageStep, min, max); break;
      case 'Home':      next = min; break;
      case 'End':       next = max; break;
      default:
        if (/^\d$/.test(event.key)) {
          event.preventDefault();
          this.typeDigit(event.key, isHour, min, max);
        }
        return; // other keys, including Tab, keep their default behaviour
    }
    event.preventDefault();
    this.setValue(isHour, next);
  }

  /** Accept typed digits; a value that cannot grow further moves focus on. */
  typeDigit(digit, isHour, min, max) {
    const candidate = Number(this.pending + digit);
    if (candidate > max) {
      this.pending = digit; // start over with the newest digit
    } else {
      this.pending += digit;
    }
    this.setValue(isHour, clamp(Number(this.pending), min, max));
    if (this.pending.length >= 2) {
      this.pending = '';
      if (isHour) this.minuteField.focus();
    }
  }

  setValue(isHour, value) {
    if (isHour) this.hour = value; else this.minute = value;
    this.render();
    this.root.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('timechange', { detail: { value: this.value } }));
  }

  /** Current time formatted as "HH:MM". */
  get value() {
    return `${pad(this.hour)}:${pad(this.minute)}`;
  }

  /** Synchronise visible text and ARIA values with internal state. */
  render() {
    this.hourField.textContent = pad(this.hour);
    this.hourField.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', String(this.hour));
    this.hourField.setAttribute('aria-valuetext', `${this.hour} hours`);
    this.minuteField.textContent = pad(this.minute);
    this.minuteField.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', String(this.minute));
    this.minuteField.setAttribute('aria-valuetext', `${this.minute} minutes`);
  }
}
```

autocomplete.js — Typeahead input with filtered suggestion list

/**
 * autocomplete.js
 *
 * Attaches a typeahead suggestion list to a text input. The widget follows
 * the ARIA combobox pattern: the input keeps keyboard focus while the
 * active option is exposed through aria-activedescendant.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   const ac = new Autocomplete(inputEl, ["Apple", "Apricot", "Banana"], {
 *     maxResults: 5,
 *     onSelect: (value) => console.log(value),
 *   });
 *   ac.destroy();
 */

const DEFAULTS = {
  minChars: 1,        // Characters required before suggestions appear.
  maxResults: 8,      // Upper limit on visible suggestions.
  caseSensitive: false,
  onSelect: null,     // Called with the chosen string.
};

let instanceCount = 0;

export class Autocomplete {
  /**
   * @param {HTMLInputElement} input   The text field to enhance.
   * @param {string[]} items           Full list of candidate strings.
   * @param {object} [options]         Overrides for DEFAULTS.
   */
  constructor(input, items, options = {}) {
    this.input = input;
    this.items = items;
    this.options = { ...DEFAULTS, ...options };
    this.matches = [];
    this.activeIndex = -1;

    instanceCount += 1;
    this.listId = `ac-list-${instanceCount}`;

    this.list = document.createElement("ul");
    this.list.id = this.listId;
    this.list.setAttribute("role", "listbox");
    this.list.hidden = true;
    input.insertAdjacentElement("afterend", this.list);

    input.setAttribute("role", "combobox");
    input.setAttribute("aria-autocomplete", "list");
    input.setAttribute("aria-controls", this.listId);
    input.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    input.setAttribute("autocomplete", "off");

    this.onInput = () => this.update();
    this.onKeydown = (event) => this.handleKey(event);
    this.onBlur = () => setTimeout(() => this.close(), 100);
    this.onListMouseDown = (event) => this.handleClick(event);

    input.addEventListener("input", this.onInput);
    input.addEventListener("keydown", this.onKeydown);
    input.addEventListener("blur", this.onBlur);
    this.list.addEventListener("mousedown", this.onListMouseDown);
  }

  /** Recompute matches for the current input value and redraw the list. */
  update() {
    const { minChars, maxResults, caseSensitive } = this.options;
    const raw = this.input.value.trim();

    if (raw.length < minChars) {
      this.close();
      return;
    }

    const needle = caseSensitive ? raw : raw.toLowerCase();
    this.matches = this.items
      .filter((item) => {
        const hay = caseSensitive ? item : item.toLowerCase();
        return hay.includes(needle);
      })
      .slice(0, maxResults);

    this.render();
  }

  /** Build option elements for the current matches. */
  render() {
    this.list.textContent = "";
    this.activeIndex = -1;

    if (this.matches.length === 0) {
      this.close();
      return;
    }

    this.matches.forEach((text, i) => {
      const li = document.createElement("li");
      li.id = `${this.listId}-opt-${i}`;
      li.setAttribute("role", "option");
      li.dataset.index = String(i);
      li.textContent = text;
      this.list.appendChild(li);
    });

    this.list.hidden = false;
    this.input.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
  }

  /** Move the highlighted option; wraps at either end of the list. */
  setActive(index) {
    const options = this.list.children;
    if (this.activeIndex >= 0) {
      options[this.activeIndex].removeAttribute("aria-selected");
    }
    this.activeIndex = index;
    if (index < 0) {
      this.input.removeAttribute("aria-activedescendant");
      return;
    }
    options[index].setAttribute("aria-selected", "true");
    this.input.setAttribute("aria-activedescendant", options[index].id);
  }

  handleKey(event) {
    const open = !this.list.hidden;
    const last = this.matches.length - 1;

    switch (event.key) {
      case "ArrowDown":
        if (!open) return this.update();
        event.preventDefault();
        this.setActive(this.activeIndex >= last ? 0 : this.activeIndex + 1);
        break;
      case "ArrowUp":
        if (!open) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        this.setActive(this.activeIndex <= 0 ? last : this.activeIndex - 1);
        break;
      case "Enter":
        if (open && this.activeIndex >= 0) {
          event.preventDefault();
          this.choose(this.activeIndex);
        }
        break;
      case "Escape":
        if (open) {
          event.preventDefault();
          this.close();
        }
        break;
    }
  }

  handleClick(event) {
    const option = event.target.closest("[role='option']");
    if (option) this.choose(Number(option.dataset.index));
  }

  /** Commit a suggestion to the input and notify the caller. */
  choose(index) {
    const value = this.matches[index];
    this.input.value = value;
    this.close();
    if (typeof this.options.onSelect === "function") {
      this.options.onSelect(value);
    }
  }

  close() {
    this.list.hidden = true;
    this.activeIndex = -1;
    this.input.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    this.input.removeAttribute("aria-activedescendant");
  }

  /** Remove listeners and generated markup. */
  destroy() {
    this.input.removeEventListener("input", this.onInput);
    this.input.removeEventListener("keydown", this.onKeydown);
    this.input.removeEventListener("blur", this.onBlur);
    this.list.removeEventListener("mousedown", this.onListMouseDown);
    this.list.remove();
    ["role", "aria-autocomplete", "aria-controls", "aria-expanded"].forEach(
      (name) => this.input.removeAttribute(name)
    );
  }
}

select-menu.js — Custom select dropdown replacing native selects accessibly

/**
 * select-menu.js
 *
 * Replaces a native <select> with a styled, keyboard-operable listbox.
 * The native element stays in the DOM (visually hidden) so form submission,
 * validation and "change" listeners continue to work unchanged.
 *
 * Pattern: a button with role="combobox" controls a role="listbox" popup.
 * Focus stays on the button; the highlighted option is exposed through
 * aria-activedescendant.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   const menu = new SelectMenu(document.querySelector('select#country'));
 *   menu.destroy(); // restores the native control
 */
let idCounter = 0;

export class SelectMenu {
  constructor(select) {
    this.select = select;
    this.uid = `select-menu-${idCounter++}`;
    this.options = Array.from(select.options);
    this.activeIndex = Math.max(select.selectedIndex, 0);
    this.typed = '';
    this.typedTimer = null;
    this.build();
    this.bind();
    this.syncFromSelect();
  }

  build() {
    this.root = document.createElement('div');
    this.root.className = 'select-menu';

    this.button = document.createElement('button');
    this.button.type = 'button';
    this.button.className = 'select-menu__button';
    this.button.setAttribute('role', 'combobox');
    this.button.setAttribute('aria-haspopup', 'listbox');
    this.button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    this.button.setAttribute('aria-controls', `${this.uid}-list`);
    this.button.disabled = this.select.disabled;

    // Reuse the label associated with the native select, if there is one.
    const label = this.select.labels && this.select.labels[0];
    if (label) {
      if (!label.id) label.id = `${this.uid}-label`;
      this.button.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', label.id);
    }

    this.list = document.createElement('ul');
    this.list.id = `${this.uid}-list`;
    this.list.className = 'select-menu__list';
    this.list.setAttribute('role', 'listbox');
    this.list.hidden = true;

    this.items = this.options.map((opt, i) => {
      const li = document.createElement('li');
      li.id = `${this.uid}-option-${i}`;
      li.className = 'select-menu__option';
      li.setAttribute('role', 'option');
      li.textContent = opt.textContent;
      if (opt.disabled) li.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
      li.addEventListener('click', () => this.choose(i));
      this.list.appendChild(li);
      return li;
    });

    this.root.append(this.button, this.list);
    this.select.classList.add('visually-hidden');
    this.select.tabIndex = -1;
    this.select.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    this.select.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', this.root);
  }

  bind() {
    this.onKeyDown = this.onKeyDown.bind(this);
    this.onDocumentClick = (event) => {
      if (!this.root.contains(event.target)) this.close();
    };
    this.button.addEventListener('keydown', this.onKeyDown);
    this.button.addEventListener('click', () => (this.isOpen() ? this.close() : this.open()));
    this.select.addEventListener('change', () => this.syncFromSelect());
    document.addEventListener('click', this.onDocumentClick);
  }

  isOpen() {
    return !this.list.hidden;
  }

  open() {
    if (this.select.disabled) return;
    this.list.hidden = false;
    this.button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    this.highlight(this.select.selectedIndex);
  }

  close() {
    this.list.hidden = true;
    this.button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    this.button.removeAttribute('aria-activedescendant');
  }

  /** Move the visual and ARIA highlight to the option at `index`. */
  highlight(index) {
    if (index < 0 || index >= this.items.length) return;
    this.activeIndex = index;
    this.items.forEach((li, i) => li.classList.toggle('is-active', i === index));
    this.button.setAttribute('aria-activedescendant', this.items[index].id);
    this.items[index].scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
  }

  /** Step to the next enabled option in `direction` (1 or -1), without wrapping. */
  move(direction) {
    let i = this.activeIndex + direction;
    while (i >= 0 && i < this.options.length && this.options[i].disabled) i += direction;
    if (i >= 0 && i < this.options.length) this.highlight(i);
  }

  /** Commit a choice to the native select and notify listeners. */
  choose(index) {
    if (this.options[index].disabled) return;
    this.select.selectedIndex = index;
    this.select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
    this.close();
    this.button.focus();
  }

  syncFromSelect() {
    const selected = this.select.selectedIndex;
    this.button.textContent = selected >= 0 ? this.options[selected].textContent : '';
    this.items.forEach((li, i) => li.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(i === selected)));
  }

  onKeyDown(event) {
    const open = this.isOpen();
    switch (event.key) {
      case 'ArrowDown': event.preventDefault(); open ? this.move(1) : this.open(); break;
      case 'ArrowUp': event.preventDefault(); open ? this.move(-1) : this.open(); break;
      case 'Home': if (open) { event.preventDefault(); this.highlight(0); } break;
      case 'End': if (open) { event.preventDefault(); this.highlight(this.items.length - 1); } break;
      case 'Enter':
      case ' ':
        event.preventDefault();
        open ? this.choose(this.activeIndex) : this.open();
        break;
      case 'Escape': if (open) { event.preventDefault(); this.close(); } break;
      case 'Tab': this.close(); break;
      default:
        if (event.key.length === 1 && !event.ctrlKey && !event.metaKey) this.typeahead(event.key);
    }
  }

  /** Jump to the first option whose text starts with the typed characters. */
  typeahead(char) {
    clearTimeout(this.typedTimer);
    this.typed += char.toLowerCase();
    this.typedTimer = setTimeout(() => { this.typed = ''; }, 500);
    const match = this.options.findIndex(
      (o) => !o.disabled && o.textContent.trim().toLowerCase().startsWith(this.typed)
    );
    if (match >= 0) {
      if (!this.isOpen()) this.open();
      this.highlight(match);
    }
  }

  destroy() {
    document.removeEventListener('click', this.onDocumentClick);
    this.root.remove();
    this.select.classList.remove('visually-hidden');
    this.select.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');
    this.select.removeAttribute('tabindex');
  }
}

multi-select.js — Multi-value selection with chips and removal controls

```js
/**
 * multi-select.js
 *
 * Multi-value selection control. Selected values are rendered as chips,
 * each with a removal button. A hidden <select multiple> stays in sync so
 * the control submits with a normal form post and participates in native
 * form validation.
 *
 * Accessibility notes:
 *  - The chip list is a labelled list; each remove button has a label that
 *    names the value it removes.
 *  - Additions and removals are announced through a polite live region.
 *  - Backspace on an empty input removes the most recent chip.
 */

const DEFAULTS = {
  maxSelected: Infinity,
  placeholder: 'Add an item',
  removeLabel: (label) => `Remove ${label}`,
  addedMessage: (label) => `${label} added`,
  removedMessage: (label) => `${label} removed`,
  limitMessage: 'The maximum number of selections has been reached',
};

export class MultiSelect {
  /**
   * @param {HTMLSelectElement} select  A <select multiple> to enhance.
   * @param {Object} [options]          Overrides for DEFAULTS.
   */
  constructor(select, options = {}) {
    if (!select || !select.multiple) {
      throw new TypeError('MultiSelect requires a <select multiple> element');
    }
    this.select = select;
    this.options = { ...DEFAULTS, ...options };
    this.listeners = [];
    this.build();
    this.render();
  }

  /** Create the visible markup and hide the native control. */
  build() {
    this.root = document.createElement('div');
    this.root.className = 'ms';

    this.chips = document.createElement('ul');
    this.chips.className = 'ms__chips';
    this.chips.setAttribute('aria-label', this.accessibleName());

    this.input = document.createElement('input');
    this.input.type = 'text';
    this.input.className = 'ms__input';
    this.input.placeholder = this.options.placeholder;
    this.input.setAttribute('list', this.ensureDatalist());

    this.status = document.createElement('div');
    this.status.className = 'ms__status visually-hidden';
    this.status.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');

    this.root.append(this.chips, this.input, this.status);
    this.select.hidden = true;
    this.select.after(this.root);

    this.on(this.input, 'keydown', (e) => this.onKeydown(e));
    this.on(this.input, 'change', () => this.commitInput());
    this.on(this.chips, 'click', (e) => this.onChipClick(e));
  }

  /** Use the label text, then aria-label, as the list name. */
  accessibleName() {
    const label = this.select.labels && this.select.labels[0];
    return label ? label.textContent.trim() : this.select.getAttribute('aria-label') || '';
  }

  /** Build a datalist from the unselected options. */
  ensureDatalist() {
    this.datalist = document.createElement('datalist');
    this.datalist.id = `${this.select.id || 'ms'}-suggestions`;
    this.root = this.root || document.createElement('div');
    document.body.append(this.datalist);
    return this.datalist.id;
  }

  /** Currently selected <option> elements, in document order. */
  get selected() {
    return Array.from(this.select.selectedOptions);
  }

  /** Select the option whose value or label matches the given text. */
  add(text) {
    const wanted = text.trim().toLowerCase();
    const option = Array.from(this.select.options).find(
      (o) => !o.selected && (o.value.toLowerCase() === wanted || o.label.toLowerCase() === wanted)
    );
    if (!option) return false;
    if (this.selected.length >= this.options.maxSelected) {
      this.announce(this.options.limitMessage);
      return false;
    }
    option.selected = true;
    this.afterChange(this.options.addedMessage(option.label));
    return true;
  }

  /** Deselect the option with the given value. */
  remove(value) {
    const option = Array.from(this.select.options).find((o) => o.value === value);
    if (!option || !option.selected) return false;
    option.selected = false;
    this.afterChange(this.options.removedMessage(option.label));
    return true;
  }

  commitInput() {
    if (this.add(this.input.value)) this.input.value = '';
  }

  onKeydown(event) {
    if (event.key === 'Enter') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.commitInput();
    } else if (event.key === 'Backspace' && this.input.value === '') {
      const last = this.selected[this.selected.length - 1];
      if (last) this.remove(last.value);
    }
  }

  onChipClick(event) {
    const button = event.target.closest('button[data-value]');
    if (!button) return;
    this.remove(button.dataset.value);
    this.input.focus(); // Keep focus in a stable place after the chip is gone.
  }

  /** Notify listeners, refresh the view, and announce the change. */
  afterChange(message) {
    this.select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
    this.render();
    this.announce(message);
  }

  /** Rebuild chips and suggestions from the select's current state. */
  render() {
    this.chips.replaceChildren(...this.selected.map((o) => this.createChip(o)));
    this.datalist.replaceChildren(
      ...Array.from(this.select.options)
        .filter((o) => !o.selected)
        .map((o) => new Option(o.label, o.value))
    );
  }

  createChip(option) {
    const item = document.createElement('li');
    item.className = 'ms__chip';
    const text = document.createElement('span');
    text.textContent = option.label;
    const button = document.createElement('button');
    button.type = 'button';
    button.dataset.value = option.value;
    button.setAttribute('aria-label', this.options.removeLabel(option.label));
    button.textContent = '\u00d7';
    item.append(text, button);
    return item;
  }

  announce(message) {
    this.status.textContent = message;
  }

  on(target, type, handler) {
    target.addEventListener(type, handler);
    this.listeners.push(() => target.removeEventListener(type, handler));
  }

  /** Remove generated markup and listeners, and restore the select. */
  destroy() {
    this.listeners.forEach((off) => off());
    this.root.remove();
    this.datalist.remove();
    this.select.hidden = false;
  }
}
```

checkbox-group.js — Manages groups of checkboxes with select-all behavior

```js
/**
 * checkbox-group.js
 *
 * Coordinates a set of checkboxes with an optional "select all" control.
 *
 * Expected markup:
 *   <fieldset data-checkbox-group>
 *     <input type="checkbox" data-group-all id="all">
 *     <input type="checkbox" data-group-item>
 *     <input type="checkbox" data-group-item>
 *   </fieldset>
 *
 * The select-all control is checked when every enabled item is checked,
 * unchecked when none are, and shown as indeterminate otherwise.
 * Disabled items are ignored by bulk operations.
 */

const DEFAULTS = {
  itemSelector: 'input[type="checkbox"][data-group-item]',
  selectAllSelector: 'input[type="checkbox"][data-group-all]',
  rangeSelect: true, // Shift+click selects the span from the previous click
  onChange: null,    // callback receiving { checked, total, values }
};

export class CheckboxGroup {
  /**
   * @param {HTMLElement} root     Container that holds the checkboxes.
   * @param {object}      options  Overrides for DEFAULTS.
   */
  constructor(root, options = {}) {
    if (!(root instanceof HTMLElement)) {
      throw new TypeError('CheckboxGroup requires an HTMLElement root.');
    }
    this.root = root;
    this.options = { ...DEFAULTS, ...options };
    this.selectAll = root.querySelector(this.options.selectAllSelector);
    this.lastClicked = null;

    this.onClick = this.onClick.bind(this);
    this.onChange = this.onChange.bind(this);
    root.addEventListener('click', this.onClick);
    root.addEventListener('change', this.onChange);

    this.linkAria();
    this.sync();
  }

  /** Enabled item checkboxes, queried live so added nodes are included. */
  get items() {
    return Array.from(this.root.querySelectorAll(this.options.itemSelector))
      .filter((box) => !box.disabled);
  }

  /** Values of all checked items. */
  get values() {
    return this.items.filter((box) => box.checked).map((box) => box.value);
  }

  /** Point the select-all control at the items it governs. */
  linkAria() {
    if (!this.selectAll) return;
    const ids = this.items.map((box) => box.id).filter(Boolean);
    if (ids.length > 0) {
      this.selectAll.setAttribute('aria-controls', ids.join(' '));
    }
  }

  /** Check or uncheck every enabled item. */
  setAll(checked) {
    this.items.forEach((box) => { box.checked = checked; });
    this.sync();
  }

  /** Handle Shift+click range selection before the change event fires. */
  onClick(event) {
    const target = event.target;
    if (!this.options.rangeSelect || !this.isItem(target)) return;

    const items = this.items;
    if (event.shiftKey && this.lastClicked && items.includes(this.lastClicked)) {
      const from = items.indexOf(this.lastClicked);
      const to = items.indexOf(target);
      const start = Math.min(from, to);
      const end = Math.max(from, to);
      for (let i = start; i <= end; i += 1) {
        items[i].checked = target.checked;
      }
    }
    this.lastClicked = target;
  }

  /** React to a user toggling the select-all control or an item. */
  onChange(event) {
    const target = event.target;
    if (target === this.selectAll) {
      this.setAll(target.checked);
    } else if (this.isItem(target)) {
      this.sync();
    }
  }

  isItem(node) {
    return node instanceof HTMLInputElement && node.matches(this.options.itemSelector);
  }

  /** Recompute select-all state and notify the caller. */
  sync() {
    const items = this.items;
    let checked = 0;
    items.forEach((box) => {
      if (box.checked) checked += 1;
    });

    if (this.selectAll) {
      const all = items.length > 0 && checked === items.length;
      this.selectAll.checked = all;
      this.selectAll.indeterminate = checked > 0 && !all;
      this.selectAll.setAttribute(
        'aria-checked',
        this.selectAll.indeterminate ? 'mixed' : String(all)
      );
      this.selectAll.disabled = items.length === 0;
    }

    if (typeof this.options.onChange === 'function') {
      this.options.onChange({ checked, total: items.length, values: this.values });
    }
  }

  /** Remove listeners and release element references. */
  destroy() {
    this.root.removeEventListener('click', this.onClick);
    this.root.removeEventListener('change', this.onChange);
    this.root = null;
    this.selectAll = null;
    this.lastClicked = null;
  }
}

/** Initialise every group on the page that carries the data attribute. */
export function initCheckboxGroups(scope = document, options = {}) {
  return Array.from(scope.querySelectorAll('[data-checkbox-group]'))
    .map((el) => new CheckboxGroup(el, options));
}
```

Notes: `sync()` is the single place where select-all state is derived, so programmatic changes to individual checkboxes can be reflected by calling it directly. Call `linkAria()` again after adding or removing items so `aria-controls` stays accurate.

radio-group.js — Roving-tabindex radio group with arrow-key navigation

/**
 * radio-group.js
 *
 * Turns a container element into an accessible radio group that follows the
 * WAI-ARIA authoring practices pattern. Only one radio is in the page tab
 * order at a time (roving tabindex). Arrow keys move focus and selection
 * between radios, wrapping at either end and skipping disabled items.
 *
 * Expected markup:
 *
 *   <div class="ui-radio-group" aria-labelledby="size-label">
 *     <div role="radio" aria-checked="false">Small</div>
 *     <div role="radio" aria-checked="true">Medium</div>
 *     <div role="radio" aria-checked="false" aria-disabled="true">Large</div>
 *   </div>
 *
 * Usage:
 *
 *   const group = new RadioGroup(document.querySelector('.ui-radio-group'));
 *   group.element.addEventListener('radiogroup:change', (e) => {
 *     console.log(e.detail.value);
 *   });
 */

const KEY_NEXT = ['ArrowRight', 'ArrowDown'];
const KEY_PREV = ['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowUp'];

export class RadioGroup {
  /**
   * @param {HTMLElement} element Container that holds the radio elements.
   */
  constructor(element) {
    if (!(element instanceof HTMLElement)) {
      throw new TypeError('RadioGroup requires an HTMLElement.');
    }
    this.element = element;
    this.element.setAttribute('role', 'radiogroup');

    this._onKeydown = this._onKeydown.bind(this);
    this._onClick = this._onClick.bind(this);

    this.element.addEventListener('keydown', this._onKeydown);
    this.element.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);

    this.refresh();
  }

  /** Returns every radio element in the group, in document order. */
  get radios() {
    return Array.from(this.element.querySelectorAll('[role="radio"]'));
  }

  /** Returns the radios that can currently receive focus. */
  get enabledRadios() {
    return this.radios.filter((radio) => !this._isDisabled(radio));
  }

  /** Returns the checked radio, or null when nothing is selected. */
  get selected() {
    return this.radios.find((r) => r.getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true') || null;
  }

  /** The value of the selected radio (data-value, falling back to text). */
  get value() {
    const radio = this.selected;
    return radio ? this._valueOf(radio) : null;
  }

  /**
   * Re-reads the DOM and rebuilds the tab order. Call this after radios are
   * added, removed, enabled, or disabled by other code.
   */
  refresh() {
    const enabled = this.enabledRadios;
    const current = this.selected;
    // The checked radio is the tab stop; otherwise the first enabled one is.
    const tabStop = current && !this._isDisabled(current) ? current : enabled[0];

    this.radios.forEach((radio) => {
      radio.setAttribute('tabindex', radio === tabStop ? '0' : '-1');
      if (!radio.hasAttribute('aria-checked')) {
        radio.setAttribute('aria-checked', 'false');
      }
    });
  }

  /**
   * Selects a radio, moves the tab stop to it, and emits a change event
   * when the selection actually differs from the previous one.
   * @param {HTMLElement} radio
   * @param {{focus?: boolean}} [options]
   */
  select(radio, { focus = true } = {}) {
    if (!radio || this._isDisabled(radio)) return;
    const previous = this.selected;

    this.radios.forEach((item) => {
      const isTarget = item === radio;
      item.setAttribute('aria-checked', String(isTarget));
      item.setAttribute('tabindex', isTarget ? '0' : '-1');
    });

    if (focus) radio.focus();

    if (previous !== radio) {
      this.element.dispatchEvent(
        new CustomEvent('radiogroup:change', {
          bubbles: true,
          detail: { value: this._valueOf(radio), element: radio },
        })
      );
    }
  }

  /** Removes listeners. The markup and ARIA state are left in place. */
  destroy() {
    this.element.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeydown);
    this.element.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const radio = event.target.closest('[role="radio"]');
    if (radio && this.element.contains(radio)) this.select(radio);
  }

  _onKeydown(event) {
    const radio = event.target.closest('[role="radio"]');
    if (!radio) return;

    const enabled = this.enabledRadios;
    const position = enabled.indexOf(radio);
    let target = null;

    if (KEY_NEXT.includes(event.key)) {
      // Wrap to the first enabled radio after the last one.
      target = enabled[position + 1] || enabled[0];
    } else if (KEY_PREV.includes(event.key)) {
      // Wrap to the last enabled radio before the first one.
      target = position > 0 ? enabled[position - 1] : enabled[enabled.length - 1];
    } else if (event.key === 'Home') {
      target = enabled[0];
    } else if (event.key === 'End') {
      target = enabled[enabled.length - 1];
    } else if (event.key === ' ' || event.key === 'Spacebar') {
      target = radio;
    } else {
      return;
    }

    // Prevent the page from scrolling while the keys are handled here.
    event.preventDefault();
    this.select(target);
  }

  _isDisabled(radio) {
    return radio.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true';
  }

  _valueOf(radio) {
    return radio.dataset.value !== undefined
      ? radio.dataset.value
      : radio.textContent.trim();
  }
}

export default RadioGroup;

toggle-switch.js — Accessible on/off switch component

/**
 * toggle-switch.js
 *
 * An accessible on/off switch. The component renders a <button> with
 * role="switch" and keeps a hidden <input> in sync so the value is
 * submitted with the surrounding form.
 *
 * Markup expected by ToggleSwitch.init():
 *
 *   <span data-toggle-switch data-name="notifications" data-checked="true">
 *     Email notifications
 *   </span>
 *
 * The text content of the host element becomes the accessible label.
 *
 * Events:
 *   "toggle:change" is dispatched on the host element and bubbles.
 *   event.detail.checked contains the new boolean state.
 */

const CLASS_ROOT = 'ui-switch';
const CLASS_ON = 'ui-switch--on';
const CLASS_DISABLED = 'ui-switch--disabled';

let idCounter = 0;

/** Returns an element id that is unique within the page. */
function nextId() {
  idCounter += 1;
  return 'ui-switch-' + idCounter;
}

export class ToggleSwitch {
  /**
   * @param {HTMLElement} host    Element that will contain the switch.
   * @param {object} [options]
   * @param {string} [options.name]      Form field name for the hidden input.
   * @param {boolean} [options.checked]  Initial state.
   * @param {boolean} [options.disabled] Disable user interaction.
   * @param {string} [options.onValue]   Submitted value when on.
   * @param {string} [options.offValue]  Submitted value when off.
   */
  constructor(host, options = {}) {
    if (!(host instanceof HTMLElement)) {
      throw new TypeError('ToggleSwitch requires an HTMLElement host.');
    }
    this.host = host;
    this.options = Object.assign(
      { name: '', checked: false, disabled: false, onValue: 'on', offValue: 'off' },
      options
    );
    this.checked = Boolean(this.options.checked);
    this.disabled = Boolean(this.options.disabled);
    this._onClick = this._onClick.bind(this);
    this._onKeyDown = this._onKeyDown.bind(this);
    this._build();
  }

  /** Creates the DOM structure and attaches listeners. */
  _build() {
    const labelText = this.host.textContent.trim();
    const labelId = nextId();

    this.label = document.createElement('span');
    this.label.id = labelId;
    this.label.className = CLASS_ROOT + '__label';
    this.label.textContent = labelText;

    this.button = document.createElement('button');
    this.button.type = 'button';
    this.button.className = CLASS_ROOT;
    this.button.setAttribute('role', 'switch');
    this.button.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', labelId);

    const track = document.createElement('span');
    track.className = CLASS_ROOT + '__track';
    track.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    track.appendChild(Object.assign(document.createElement('span'), {
      className: CLASS_ROOT + '__thumb'
    }));
    this.button.appendChild(track);

    this.input = document.createElement('input');
    this.input.type = 'hidden';
    if (this.options.name) this.input.name = this.options.name;

    this.host.textContent = '';
    this.host.append(this.button, this.label, this.input);

    this.button.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
    this.button.addEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
    this._render();
  }

  /** Synchronises attributes, classes and the hidden input with state. */
  _render() {
    this.button.setAttribute('aria-checked', String(this.checked));
    this.button.disabled = this.disabled;
    this.button.classList.toggle(CLASS_ON, this.checked);
    this.button.classList.toggle(CLASS_DISABLED, this.disabled);
    this.input.value = this.checked ? this.options.onValue : this.options.offValue;
  }

  _onClick() {
    if (!this.disabled) this.toggle();
  }

  /**
   * Native buttons already respond to Space and Enter. Arrow keys are
   * added because many switch implementations allow them: Right turns
   * the switch on and Left turns it off.
   */
  _onKeyDown(event) {
    if (this.disabled) return;
    if (event.key === 'ArrowRight') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.setChecked(true);
    } else if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.setChecked(false);
    }
  }

  /** Flips the current state. */
  toggle() {
    this.setChecked(!this.checked);
  }

  /**
   * Sets the state explicitly. An event is dispatched only when the
   * value actually changes.
   * @param {boolean} value
   */
  setChecked(value) {
    const next = Boolean(value);
    if (next === this.checked) return;
    this.checked = next;
    this._render();
    this.host.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle:change', {
      bubbles: true,
      detail: { checked: this.checked }
    }));
  }

  /** Enables or disables the switch. */
  setDisabled(value) {
    this.disabled = Boolean(value);
    this._render();
  }

  /** Removes listeners so the instance can be garbage collected. */
  destroy() {
    this.button.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
    this.button.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
  }

  /**
   * Initialises every [data-toggle-switch] element under root.
   * @param {ParentNode} [root=document]
   * @returns {ToggleSwitch[]}
   */
  static init(root = document) {
    const hosts = root.querySelectorAll('[data-toggle-switch]');
    return Array.from(hosts).map((host) => new ToggleSwitch(host, {
      name: host.dataset.name || '',
      checked: host.dataset.checked === 'true',
      disabled: host.hasAttribute('data-disabled')
    }));
  }
}

export default ToggleSwitch;

file-upload.js — File input with validation, previews, and progress

/**
 * file-upload.js
 *
 * Enhances a native <input type="file"> with client-side validation,
 * image previews, and per-file upload progress. The native input stays in
 * the DOM so keyboard and screen reader behaviour is preserved. Errors are
 * announced through an aria-live region linked with aria-describedby.
 *
 * Events (dispatched on the input, bubbling):
 *   fileupload:invalid   detail: { file, reason }
 *   fileupload:progress  detail: { file, percent }
 *   fileupload:done      detail: { file, response }
 *   fileupload:fail      detail: { file, status }
 */

const DEFAULTS = {
  maxSize: 5242880,            // bytes per file
  maxFiles: 5,
  accept: ['image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/gif', 'application/pdf'],
  url: null,                   // upload endpoint; null disables uploading
  fieldName: 'file',
  messages: {
    type: (name) => `${name} is not an allowed file type.`,
    size: (name) => `${name} is larger than the allowed size.`,
    count: (max) => `You can select at most ${max} files.`,
  },
};

export class FileUpload {
  /**
   * @param {HTMLInputElement} input  The file input to enhance.
   * @param {Object} [options]        Overrides for DEFAULTS.
   */
  constructor(input, options = {}) {
    this.input = input;
    this.options = { ...DEFAULTS, ...options };
    this.options.messages = { ...DEFAULTS.messages, ...options.messages };
    this.items = new Map();    // File -> { row, bar, url, xhr }

    this.list = document.createElement('ul');
    this.list.className = 'fu-list';
    this.status = document.createElement('div');
    this.status.className = 'fu-status';
    this.status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
    this.status.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
    this.status.id = `${input.id || 'fu'}-status`;

    input.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', this.status);
    this.status.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', this.list);
    input.setAttribute('aria-describedby', this.status.id);

    this._onChange = this._onChange.bind(this);
    input.addEventListener('change', this._onChange);
  }

  /** Returns a reason code for a rejected file, or null if it is valid. */
  validate(file) {
    const { accept, maxSize } = this.options;
    if (accept.length && !accept.includes(file.type)) return 'type';
    if (file.size > maxSize) return 'size';
    return null;
  }

  _onChange() {
    const files = Array.from(this.input.files);
    const { maxFiles, messages } = this.options;
    const errors = [];

    if (files.length > maxFiles) {
      errors.push(messages.count(maxFiles));
    }

    const accepted = [];
    for (const file of files.slice(0, maxFiles)) {
      const reason = this.validate(file);
      if (reason) {
        errors.push(messages[reason](file.name));
        this._emit('invalid', { file, reason });
      } else {
        accepted.push(file);
      }
    }

    this._clear();
    this._announce(errors);
    this.input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', errors.length ? 'true' : 'false');
    accepted.forEach((file) => this._add(file));
  }

  _add(file) {
    const row = document.createElement('li');
    row.className = 'fu-item';

    const url = file.type.startsWith('image/') ? URL.createObjectURL(file) : null;
    if (url) {
      const img = document.createElement('img');
      img.src = url;
      img.alt = `Preview of ${file.name}`;
      img.width = 48;
      row.appendChild(img);
    }

    const label = document.createElement('span');
    label.textContent = file.name;
    row.appendChild(label);

    const bar = document.createElement('progress');
    bar.max = 100;
    bar.value = 0;
    bar.setAttribute('aria-label', `Upload progress for ${file.name}`);
    row.appendChild(bar);

    this.list.appendChild(row);
    const item = { row, bar, url, xhr: null };
    this.items.set(file, item);

    if (this.options.url) this._upload(file, item);
  }

  _upload(file, item) {
    const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
    item.xhr = xhr;
    xhr.open('POST', this.options.url);

    xhr.upload.addEventListener('progress', (e) => {
      if (!e.lengthComputable) return;
      const percent = Math.round((e.loaded / e.total) * 100);
      item.bar.value = percent;
      this._emit('progress', { file, percent });
    });

    xhr.addEventListener('load', () => {
      if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) {
        item.bar.value = 100;
        this._emit('done', { file, response: xhr.responseText });
      } else {
        this._emit('fail', { file, status: xhr.status });
      }
    });
    xhr.addEventListener('error', () => this._emit('fail', { file, status: 0 }));

    const body = new FormData();
    body.append(this.options.fieldName, file, file.name);
    xhr.send(body);
  }

  /** Aborts requests and releases object URLs created for previews. */
  _clear() {
    for (const item of this.items.values()) {
      if (item.xhr) item.xhr.abort();
      if (item.url) URL.revokeObjectURL(item.url);
    }
    this.items.clear();
    this.list.textContent = '';
  }

  _announce(errors) {
    this.status.textContent = errors.join(' ');
  }

  _emit(name, detail) {
    this.input.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent(`fileupload:${name}`, { detail, bubbles: true })
    );
  }

  /** Removes listeners and generated elements. */
  destroy() {
    this._clear();
    this.input.removeEventListener('change', this._onChange);
    this.input.removeAttribute('aria-describedby');
    this.status.remove();
    this.list.remove();
  }
}

drag-drop-zone.js — Drag-and-drop area for files and sortable items

```js
/**
 * drag-drop-zone.js
 *
 * Turns a container element into a drop target for files and, optionally,
 * a list whose child items can be reordered with the mouse or keyboard.
 *
 * Accessibility notes:
 *  - A visually hidden file input remains available, so users who cannot
 *    drag can still choose files with the standard browser dialog.
 *  - Results are announced through a polite live region.
 *  - Sortable items are reordered from the keyboard: Space grabs or drops
 *    an item, and the Arrow Up / Arrow Down keys move it.
 */
'use strict';

const DEFAULTS = {
  accept: [],               // e.g. ['image/*', '.pdf']
  multiple: true,
  maxSize: null,            // bytes per file; null means no limit
  sortable: false,
  itemSelector: '[data-sortable-item]',
  activeClass: 'is-dragover',
  onFiles: function () {},
  onReject: function () {},
  onReorder: function () {}
};

export class DragDropZone {
  /**
   * @param {HTMLElement} element  The drop zone container.
   * @param {Object} [options]     Overrides for DEFAULTS.
   */
  constructor(element, options) {
    this.el = element;
    this.opts = Object.assign({}, DEFAULTS, options);
    this.input = element.querySelector('input[type="file"]');
    this.grabbed = null;
    this.draggedItem = null;
    this.live = this._createLiveRegion();
    this._handlers = this._bind();
    this._attach();
  }

  /** Create the polite live region used for status announcements. */
  _createLiveRegion() {
    const region = document.createElement('div');
    region.setAttribute('role', 'status');
    region.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
    region.className = 'visually-hidden';
    this.el.appendChild(region);
    return region;
  }

  _announce(message) {
    this.live.textContent = message;
  }

  /** Keep one bound reference per handler so destroy() can remove them. */
  _bind() {
    const names = ['dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop', 'change', 'dragstart', 'dragend', 'keydown'];
    const bound = {};
    names.forEach((name) => {
      bound[name] = this['_on' + name].bind(this);
    });
    return bound;
  }

  _attach() {
    const h = this._handlers;
    ['dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop', 'dragstart', 'dragend', 'keydown'].forEach((name) => {
      this.el.addEventListener(name, h[name]);
    });
    if (this.input) {
      this.input.multiple = this.opts.multiple;
      this.input.addEventListener('change', h.change);
    }
    if (this.opts.sortable) {
      this._items().forEach((item) => {
        item.draggable = true;
        item.tabIndex = 0;
        item.setAttribute('aria-grabbed', 'false');
      });
    }
  }

  _items() {
    return Array.from(this.el.querySelectorAll(this.opts.itemSelector));
  }

  _isFileDrag(event) {
    const types = event.dataTransfer && event.dataTransfer.types;
    return Boolean(types) && Array.from(types).includes('Files');
  }

  _ondragover(event) {
    if (this.draggedItem || this._isFileDrag(event)) {
      event.preventDefault();
      if (!this.draggedItem) this.el.classList.add(this.opts.activeClass);
    }
  }

  _ondragleave(event) {
    // Ignore leave events fired when moving between child elements.
    if (!this.el.contains(event.relatedTarget)) {
      this.el.classList.remove(this.opts.activeClass);
    }
  }

  _ondrop(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    this.el.classList.remove(this.opts.activeClass);
    if (this.draggedItem) {
      const target = event.target.closest(this.opts.itemSelector);
      if (target && target !== this.draggedItem) this._place(this.draggedItem, target);
      return;
    }
    if (this._isFileDrag(event)) this._handleFiles(Array.from(event.dataTransfer.files));
  }

  _onchange() {
    this._handleFiles(Array.from(this.input.files));
    this.input.value = '';
  }

  /** Split incoming files into accepted and rejected lists. */
  _handleFiles(files) {
    const list = this.opts.multiple ? files : files.slice(0, 1);
    const accepted = [];
    const rejected = [];
    list.forEach((file) => {
      const reason = this._validate(file);
      if (reason) rejected.push({ file: file, reason: reason });
      else accepted.push(file);
    });
    if (accepted.length) this.opts.onFiles(accepted);
    if (rejected.length) this.opts.onReject(rejected);
    this._announce(accepted.length + ' added, ' + rejected.length + ' rejected.');
  }

  /** Return a reason string if the file is not allowed, otherwise null. */
  _validate(file) {
    const { accept, maxSize } = this.opts;
    if (maxSize !== null && file.size > maxSize) return 'too-large';
    if (!accept.length) return null;
    const name = file.name.toLowerCase();
    const ok = accept.some((rule) => {
      if (rule.startsWith('.')) return name.endsWith(rule.toLowerCase());
      if (rule.endsWith('/*')) return file.type.startsWith(rule.slice(0, -1));
      return file.type === rule;
    });
    return ok ? null : 'type-not-allowed';
  }

  _ondragstart(event) {
    const item = event.target.closest(this.opts.itemSelector);
    if (!this.opts.sortable || !item) return;
    this.draggedItem = item;
    event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
    event.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', '');
  }

  _ondragend() {
    this.draggedItem = null;
  }

  /** Insert `item` before `target`, or after it when moving downward. */
  _place(item, target) {
    const items = this._items();
    const movingDown = items.indexOf(item) < items.indexOf(target);
    target.parentNode.insertBefore(item, movingDown ? target.nextSibling : target);
    this.opts.onReorder(this._items(), item);
    item.focus();
  }

  _onkeydown(event) {
    const item = event.target.closest(this.opts.itemSelector);
    if (!this.opts.sortable || !item) return;
    if (event.key === ' ') {
      event.preventDefault();
      const grabbing = this.grabbed !== item;
      this.grabbed = grabbing ? item : null;
      item.setAttribute('aria-grabbed', String(grabbing));
      this._announce(grabbing ? 'Item grabbed.' : 'Item dropped.');
    } else if (this.grabbed === item && (event.key === 'ArrowUp' || event.key === 'ArrowDown')) {
      event.preventDefault();
      const neighbour = event.key === 'ArrowUp' ? item.previousElementSibling : item.nextElementSibling;
      if (neighbour) this._place(item, neighbour);
    }
  }

  /** Remove listeners and the live region. */
  destroy() {
    const h = this._handlers;
    ['dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop', 'dragstart', 'dragend', 'keydown'].forEach((name) => {
      this.el.removeEventListener(name, h[name]);
    });
    if (this.input) this.input.removeEventListener('change', h.change);
    this.live.remove();
  }
}
```

password-field.js — Password input with visibility toggle and strength meter

```js
/**
 * password-field.js
 *
 * Enhances a native <input type="password"> with:
 *   - a visibility toggle button (keyboard and screen reader friendly)
 *   - a strength meter with a text description in a polite live region
 *
 * The original input is never replaced, so form submission, autofill
 * and server-side validation keep working unchanged.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   const field = new PasswordField(document.querySelector('#password'));
 *   field.on('strengthchange', (e) => console.log(e.detail.label));
 */

const RULES = [
  { id: 'length',    test: (v, o) => v.length >= o.minLength },
  { id: 'lowercase', test: (v) => /[a-z]/.test(v) },
  { id: 'uppercase', test: (v) => /[A-Z]/.test(v) },
  { id: 'digit',     test: (v) => /\d/.test(v) },
  { id: 'symbol',    test: (v) => /[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(v) },
];

const DEFAULTS = {
  minLength: 12,
  showLabel: 'Show password',
  hideLabel: 'Hide password',
  strengthLabels: ['Empty', 'Very weak', 'Weak', 'Fair', 'Strong', 'Very strong'],
  showMeter: true,
};

let instanceCounter = 0;

/**
 * Count how many rules a password satisfies.
 * @param {string} value
 * @param {object} options
 * @returns {number} Number of satisfied rules, from zero to RULES.length.
 */
export function scorePassword(value, options = DEFAULTS) {
  if (!value) return 0;
  let score = 0;
  for (const rule of RULES) {
    if (rule.test(value, options)) score += 1;
  }
  return score;
}

export class PasswordField {
  /**
   * @param {HTMLInputElement} input  The password input to enhance.
   * @param {Partial<typeof DEFAULTS>} [options]
   */
  constructor(input, options = {}) {
    if (!(input instanceof HTMLInputElement)) {
      throw new TypeError('PasswordField expects an input element.');
    }
    this.input = input;
    this.options = { ...DEFAULTS, ...options };
    this.score = 0;
    this.uid = `pwf-${instanceCounter++}`;
    this._onInput = this._onInput.bind(this);
    this._onToggle = this._onToggle.bind(this);
    this._build();
  }

  /** Create the wrapper, toggle button and meter around the input. */
  _build() {
    const { input, options } = this;
    if (!input.id) input.id = `${this.uid}-input`;

    this.wrapper = document.createElement('div');
    this.wrapper.className = 'pwf';
    input.parentNode.insertBefore(this.wrapper, input);
    this.wrapper.appendChild(input);

    this.toggle = document.createElement('button');
    this.toggle.type = 'button';
    this.toggle.className = 'pwf__toggle';
    this.toggle.setAttribute('aria-controls', input.id);
    this.toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
    this.toggle.textContent = options.showLabel;
    this.toggle.addEventListener('click', this._onToggle);
    this.wrapper.appendChild(this.toggle);

    if (options.showMeter) {
      this.meter = document.createElement('meter');
      this.meter.className = 'pwf__meter';
      this.meter.min = 0;
      this.meter.max = RULES.length;
      this.meter.value = 0;
      this.meter.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');

      // The live region carries the same information for assistive tech.
      this.status = document.createElement('p');
      this.status.className = 'pwf__status';
      this.status.id = `${this.uid}-status`;
      this.status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
      this.status.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');

      input.setAttribute('aria-describedby', this.status.id);
      this.wrapper.append(this.meter, this.status);
      input.addEventListener('input', this._onInput);
      this._update();
    }
  }

  /** Switch the input between masked and plain text display. */
  _onToggle() {
    const reveal = this.input.type === 'password';
    this.input.type = reveal ? 'text' : 'password';
    this.toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(reveal));
    this.toggle.textContent = reveal
      ? this.options.hideLabel
      : this.options.showLabel;
    // Return focus to the field so typing can continue immediately.
    this.input.focus();
  }

  _onInput() {
    this._update();
  }

  /** Recalculate the score and notify listeners only when it changes. */
  _update() {
    const next = scorePassword(this.input.value, this.options);
    this.meter.value = next;
    this.status.textContent = this.options.strengthLabels[next];
    if (next !== this.score) {
      this.score = next;
      this.input.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('strengthchange', {
        bubbles: true,
        detail: { score: next, label: this.options.strengthLabels[next] },
      }));
    }
  }

  /** Register a listener for events dispatched on the input. */
  on(type, handler) {
    this.input.addEventListener(type, handler);
    return this;
  }

  /** Remove listeners and restore the original DOM structure. */
  destroy() {
    this.input.removeEventListener('input', this._onInput);
    this.toggle.removeEventListener('click', this._onToggle);
    this.input.type = 'password';
    this.input.removeAttribute('aria-describedby');
    this.wrapper.parentNode.insertBefore(this.input, this.wrapper);
    this.wrapper.remove();
  }
}
```

character-counter.js — Live character and word count with limits

```js
/**
 * character-counter.js
 *
 * Attaches a live character and word counter to a text input or textarea.
 * Supports an optional character limit and word limit, a warning state
 * that appears as the user nears a limit, and an optional hard limit that
 * truncates input.
 *
 * Accessibility notes:
 *  - The visible counter is hidden from assistive technology so that it is
 *    not read on every keystroke.
 *  - A separate polite live region is updated after the user pauses typing.
 *  - The field is linked to the counter through aria-describedby and is
 *    marked aria-invalid while a limit is exceeded.
 */

const DEFAULTS = {
  maxChars: null,       // maximum characters, or null for no limit
  maxWords: null,       // maximum words, or null for no limit
  warnRatio: 0.9,       // fraction of a limit at which the warning state starts
  hardLimit: false,     // truncate input instead of only reporting the overflow
  announceDelay: 600,   // milliseconds of inactivity before the live region updates
  visibleOutput: null,  // element that shows the counter; created if omitted
};

/** Count words separated by whitespace. Empty or blank text has no words. */
export function countWords(text) {
  const trimmed = text.trim();
  return trimmed === '' ? 0 : trimmed.split(/\s+/).length;
}

/** Count user-perceived characters by code point, so emoji are not split. */
export function countCharacters(text) {
  return Array.from(text).length;
}

/** Return "ok", "warning" or "over" for a value measured against a limit. */
function stateFor(value, limit, warnRatio) {
  if (limit === null) return 'ok';
  if (value > limit) return 'over';
  return value >= limit * warnRatio ? 'warning' : 'ok';
}

/** Combine two states and keep the more severe one. */
function worst(a, b) {
  const order = ['ok', 'warning', 'over'];
  return order.indexOf(a) >= order.indexOf(b) ? a : b;
}

/** Build the message used for both the visible and the spoken output. */
function describe(chars, words, opts) {
  const parts = [];
  if (opts.maxChars !== null) {
    const left = opts.maxChars - chars;
    parts.push(left >= 0
      ? `${left} characters remaining`
      : `${-left} characters over the limit`);
  } else {
    parts.push(`${chars} characters`);
  }
  if (opts.maxWords !== null) {
    const left = opts.maxWords - words;
    parts.push(left >= 0
      ? `${left} words remaining`
      : `${-left} words over the limit`);
  } else {
    parts.push(`${words} words`);
  }
  return parts.join(', ');
}

/**
 * Create a counter for a field.
 *
 * @param {HTMLInputElement|HTMLTextAreaElement} field
 * @param {Partial<typeof DEFAULTS>} [options]
 * @returns {{ update: () => void, destroy: () => void }}
 */
export function createCharacterCounter(field, options = {}) {
  const opts = { ...DEFAULTS, ...options };
  const baseId = field.id || 'field';

  const visible = opts.visibleOutput || document.createElement('div');
  if (!opts.visibleOutput) field.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', visible);
  visible.classList.add('char-counter');
  visible.id = visible.id || `${baseId}-counter`;
  visible.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');

  const status = document.createElement('div');
  status.className = 'visually-hidden';
  status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
  status.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
  visible.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', status);

  const previousDescribedBy = field.getAttribute('aria-describedby');
  field.setAttribute(
    'aria-describedby',
    [previousDescribedBy, visible.id].filter(Boolean).join(' ')
  );

  let timer = null;

  function update() {
    if (opts.hardLimit && opts.maxChars !== null) {
      const points = Array.from(field.value);
      if (points.length > opts.maxChars) {
        field.value = points.slice(0, opts.maxChars).join('');
      }
    }

    const chars = countCharacters(field.value);
    const words = countWords(field.value);
    const state = worst(
      stateFor(chars, opts.maxChars, opts.warnRatio),
      stateFor(words, opts.maxWords, opts.warnRatio)
    );
    const message = describe(chars, words, opts);

    visible.textContent = message;
    visible.dataset.state = state;
    field.toggleAttribute('aria-invalid', state === 'over');
    if (state === 'over') field.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');

    clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = setTimeout(() => { status.textContent = message; }, opts.announceDelay);
  }

  field.addEventListener('input', update);
  update();

  return {
    update,
    destroy() {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      field.removeEventListener('input', update);
      if (previousDescribedBy === null) field.removeAttribute('aria-describedby');
      else field.setAttribute('aria-describedby', previousDescribedBy);
      field.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
      status.remove();
      if (!options.visibleOutput) visible.remove();
    },
  };
}
```
