form-wizard.js — Multi-step form flow with per-step validation

/**
 * form-wizard.js
 *
 * Splits a long form into sequential steps. Each step is validated before the
 * user may move forward. Moving backward is always allowed and never validates.
 *
 * Markup contract:
 *   <form data-wizard>
 *     <fieldset data-wizard-step data-step-title="Account"> ... </fieldset>
 *     <fieldset data-wizard-step data-step-title="Profile"> ... </fieldset>
 *   </form>
 *
 * Validators are registered per step name and return an array of error objects
 * of the shape { field: HTMLElement, message: string }. An empty array means
 * the step is valid.
 */

const HIDDEN_CLASS = 'wizard-step--hidden';
const INVALID_ATTR = 'aria-invalid';

export class FormWizard {
  /**
   * @param {HTMLFormElement} form - The form element containing the steps.
   * @param {Object} [options]
   * @param {Object<string, Function>} [options.validators] - Map of step title to validator.
   * @param {Function} [options.onStepChange] - Called with (index, stepElement).
   * @param {Function} [options.onSubmit] - Called with (FormData) after the final step validates.
   */
  constructor(form, options = {}) {
    this.form = form;
    this.steps = Array.from(form.querySelectorAll('[data-wizard-step]'));
    this.validators = options.validators || {};
    this.onStepChange = options.onStepChange || (() => {});
    this.onSubmit = options.onSubmit || null;
    this.currentIndex = 0;
    this.liveRegion = this._createLiveRegion();

    this.form.setAttribute('novalidate', '');
    this.form.addEventListener('submit', (event) => this._handleSubmit(event));
    this.showStep(0);
  }

  /** Create a polite live region so step changes and errors are announced. */
  _createLiveRegion() {
    const region = document.createElement('div');
    region.setAttribute('role', 'status');
    region.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
    region.className = 'visually-hidden';
    this.form.appendChild(region);
    return region;
  }

  /** Return true when the current step is the last one. */
  isLastStep() {
    return this.currentIndex === this.steps.length - 1;
  }

  /** Show the step at the given index and hide all others. */
  showStep(index) {
    this.steps.forEach((step, i) => {
      const active = i === index;
      step.classList.toggle(HIDDEN_CLASS, !active);
      step.hidden = !active;
    });
    this.currentIndex = index;

    const step = this.steps[index];
    const title = step.dataset.stepTitle || 'Step ' + (index + 1);
    this.liveRegion.textContent = title + ', step ' + (index + 1) + ' of ' + this.steps.length;

    this._focusFirstField(step);
    this.onStepChange(index, step);
  }

  /** Move focus to the first focusable control in the step. */
  _focusFirstField(step) {
    const target = step.querySelector('input, select, textarea, button');
    if (target) target.focus();
  }

  /**
   * Run the validator registered for the step, update ARIA state on each
   * field, and return the list of errors.
   */
  validateStep(index) {
    const step = this.steps[index];
    this._clearErrors(step);

    const validator = this.validators[step.dataset.stepTitle];
    const errors = validator ? validator(step, new FormData(this.form)) : [];

    errors.forEach(({ field, message }) => {
      field.setAttribute(INVALID_ATTR, 'true');
      const messageId = field.id + '-error';
      let node = document.getElementById(messageId);
      if (!node) {
        node = document.createElement('span');
        node.id = messageId;
        node.className = 'field-error';
        field.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', node);
      }
      node.textContent = message;
      field.setAttribute('aria-describedby', messageId);
    });

    return errors;
  }

  /** Remove error messages and invalid state from every field in a step. */
  _clearErrors(step) {
    step.querySelectorAll('[' + INVALID_ATTR + ']').forEach((field) => {
      field.removeAttribute(INVALID_ATTR);
      field.removeAttribute('aria-describedby');
    });
    step.querySelectorAll('.field-error').forEach((node) => node.remove());
  }

  /** Advance to the next step if the current one is valid. */
  next() {
    const errors = this.validateStep(this.currentIndex);
    if (errors.length > 0) {
      this.liveRegion.textContent = 'This step has errors that need to be corrected.';
      errors[0].field.focus();
      return false;
    }
    if (!this.isLastStep()) this.showStep(this.currentIndex + 1);
    return true;
  }

  /** Return to the previous step without validating. */
  previous() {
    if (this.currentIndex > 0) this.showStep(this.currentIndex - 1);
  }

  /** Intercept submit: advance until the last step, then submit. */
  _handleSubmit(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!this.next() || !this.isLastStep()) return;
    if (this.onSubmit) this.onSubmit(new FormData(this.form));
  }
}

conditional-fields.js — Show or hide fields based on other field values

```js
/**
 * conditional-fields.js
 *
 * Shows or hides form fields depending on the values of other fields.
 * A dependent element declares its rule in a data attribute:
 *
 *   <div data-show-when='{"field":"country","op":"in","value":["US","CA"]}'>
 *
 * Several conditions can be combined with "all" or "any":
 *
 *   <div data-show-when='{"any":[
 *     {"field":"contact","op":"equals","value":"phone"},
 *     {"field":"newsletter","op":"checked"}
 *   ]}'>
 *
 * While hidden, controls inside the element are disabled so they are not
 * submitted or validated. Their previous disabled state is restored when
 * the element is shown again.
 */

const OPERATORS = {
  equals: (actual, expected) => actual === String(expected),
  notEquals: (actual, expected) => actual !== String(expected),
  in: (actual, expected) => expected.map(String).includes(actual),
  notIn: (actual, expected) => !expected.map(String).includes(actual),
  empty: (actual) => actual === "",
  notEmpty: (actual) => actual !== "",
  matches: (actual, expected) => new RegExp(expected).test(actual),
  checked: (actual, expected, control) => control.checked === true,
};

/**
 * Read the current value of a named field in a form. Radio groups return
 * the checked option's value, or "" when none is selected. Checkbox groups
 * return the first checked value.
 */
function readValue(form, name) {
  const controls = Array.from(form.elements).filter((el) => el.name === name);
  if (controls.length === 0) return { value: "", control: null };

  const first = controls[0];
  if (first.type === "radio" || first.type === "checkbox") {
    const picked = controls.find((el) => el.checked);
    return { value: picked ? picked.value : "", control: picked || first };
  }
  return { value: first.value, control: first };
}

/** Evaluate a single condition or a nested all/any group. */
function evaluate(form, rule) {
  if (Array.isArray(rule.all)) return rule.all.every((r) => evaluate(form, r));
  if (Array.isArray(rule.any)) return rule.any.some((r) => evaluate(form, r));

  const test = OPERATORS[rule.op || "equals"];
  if (!test) throw new Error(`conditional-fields: unknown operator "${rule.op}"`);

  const { value, control } = readValue(form, rule.field);
  return test(value, rule.value, control);
}

/** Collect every field name referenced by a rule, for event wiring. */
function collectFields(rule, names = new Set()) {
  (rule.all || rule.any || []).forEach((r) => collectFields(r, names));
  if (rule.field) names.add(rule.field);
  return names;
}

/** Disable or restore the controls inside a dependent element. */
function setControlsEnabled(container, enabled) {
  container.querySelectorAll("input, select, textarea, button").forEach((el) => {
    if (!enabled) {
      if (el.dataset.cfWasDisabled === undefined) {
        el.dataset.cfWasDisabled = el.disabled ? "true" : "false";
      }
      el.disabled = true;
    } else if (el.dataset.cfWasDisabled !== undefined) {
      el.disabled = el.dataset.cfWasDisabled === "true";
      delete el.dataset.cfWasDisabled;
    }
  });
}

/** Apply the visible or hidden state and notify listeners on change. */
function applyState(container, visible) {
  const previous = container.hidden === false;
  container.hidden = !visible;
  container.setAttribute("aria-hidden", String(!visible));
  setControlsEnabled(container, visible);

  if (previous !== visible) {
    container.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent("conditionalfields:change", {
        bubbles: true,
        detail: { visible },
      })
    );
  }
}

/**
 * Initialise conditional fields for one form.
 * Returns an object with refresh() to re-evaluate all rules and
 * destroy() to remove the listeners added here.
 */
export function initConditionalFields(form) {
  const entries = Array.from(form.querySelectorAll("[data-show-when]")).map(
    (container) => {
      const rule = JSON.parse(container.dataset.showWhen);
      return { container, rule, fields: collectFields(rule) };
    }
  );

  const refresh = () => {
    entries.forEach(({ container, rule }) => {
      applyState(container, evaluate(form, rule));
    });
  };

  // One delegated listener covers inputs, selects and radio groups.
  const onChange = (event) => {
    const name = event.target.name;
    entries.forEach(({ container, rule, fields }) => {
      if (fields.has(name)) applyState(container, evaluate(form, rule));
    });
  };

  form.addEventListener("input", onChange);
  form.addEventListener("change", onChange);
  form.addEventListener("reset", () => setTimeout(refresh));

  refresh();

  return {
    refresh,
    destroy() {
      form.removeEventListener("input", onChange);
      form.removeEventListener("change", onChange);
    },
  };
}
```

Disabling hidden controls keeps them out of the submitted data and out of constraint validation, so a required field in a collapsed section never blocks submission. The `aria-hidden` attribute is set alongside `hidden` so assistive technology receives the same state that sighted users see.

modal.js — Core modal dialog component with open and close lifecycle

```js
/**
 * modal.js
 * Core modal dialog component. Manages the open/close lifecycle, focus
 * handling, and the ARIA attributes needed for assistive technology.
 *
 * Lifecycle events (dispatched on the modal element, all bubble):
 *   modal:beforeopen   cancelable; call preventDefault() to stop opening
 *   modal:open         dispatched after the modal is visible and focused
 *   modal:beforeclose  cancelable; detail.reason describes the trigger
 *   modal:close        dispatched after the modal is hidden
 */

const FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR = [
  'a[href]',
  'button:not([disabled])',
  'input:not([disabled]):not([type="hidden"])',
  'select:not([disabled])',
  'textarea:not([disabled])',
  '[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'
].join(',');

export const ModalState = Object.freeze({
  CLOSED: 'closed',
  OPEN: 'open'
});

const DEFAULTS = {
  closeOnEscape: true,
  closeOnBackdrop: true,
  restoreFocus: true,
  initialFocus: null,       // selector or element; falls back to first focusable
  openClass: 'ui-modal--open',
  closeSelector: '[data-modal-close]'
};

export class Modal {
  /**
   * @param {HTMLElement} element  Root element of the dialog.
   * @param {Partial<typeof DEFAULTS>} [options]
   */
  constructor(element, options = {}) {
    if (!(element instanceof HTMLElement)) {
      throw new TypeError('Modal requires an HTMLElement.');
    }
    this.element = element;
    this.options = { ...DEFAULTS, ...options };
    this.state = ModalState.CLOSED;
    this._previouslyFocused = null;

    // Bind once so the same references can be removed later.
    this._onKeydown = this._onKeydown.bind(this);
    this._onClick = this._onClick.bind(this);

    element.setAttribute('role', 'dialog');
    element.setAttribute('aria-modal', 'true');
    element.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    element.hidden = true;
    if (!element.hasAttribute('tabindex')) {
      element.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
    }
  }

  get isOpen() {
    return this.state === ModalState.OPEN;
  }

  /** Opens the modal. Returns true if it opened, false if it was cancelled. */
  open() {
    if (this.isOpen) return true;
    if (!this._emit('modal:beforeopen', {}, true)) return false;

    this._previouslyFocused = document.activeElement;
    this.element.hidden = false;
    this.element.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');
    this.element.classList.add(this.options.openClass);
    this.state = ModalState.OPEN;

    document.addEventListener('keydown', this._onKeydown, true);
    this.element.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);

    this._focusInitial();
    this._emit('modal:open');
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Closes the modal.
   * @param {string} [reason='api']  'api', 'escape', 'backdrop' or 'button'.
   * @returns {boolean} true if closed, false if a listener cancelled it.
   */
  close(reason = 'api') {
    if (!this.isOpen) return true;
    if (!this._emit('modal:beforeclose', { reason }, true)) return false;

    document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeydown, true);
    this.element.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);

    this.element.classList.remove(this.options.openClass);
    this.element.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    this.element.hidden = true;
    this.state = ModalState.CLOSED;

    const target = this._previouslyFocused;
    if (this.options.restoreFocus && target && document.contains(target)) {
      target.focus();
    }
    this._previouslyFocused = null;

    this._emit('modal:close', { reason });
    return true;
  }

  /** Removes listeners and leaves the element in its closed state. */
  destroy() {
    this.close('api');
    this.element.removeAttribute('role');
    this.element.removeAttribute('aria-modal');
  }

  _focusInitial() {
    const { initialFocus } = this.options;
    let target = null;
    if (typeof initialFocus === 'string') {
      target = this.element.querySelector(initialFocus);
    } else if (initialFocus instanceof HTMLElement) {
      target = initialFocus;
    }
    target = target || this._focusable()[0] || this.element;
    target.focus();
  }

  _focusable() {
    return Array.from(this.element.querySelectorAll(FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR))
      .filter((node) => !node.hidden && node.offsetParent !== null);
  }

  _onKeydown(event) {
    if (event.key === 'Escape' && this.options.closeOnEscape) {
      event.stopPropagation();
      this.close('escape');
      return;
    }
    if (event.key !== 'Tab') return;

    // Keep keyboard focus cycling inside the dialog.
    const nodes = this._focusable();
    if (nodes.length === 0) {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.element.focus();
      return;
    }
    const first = nodes[0];
    const last = nodes[nodes.length - 1];
    const active = document.activeElement;

    if (event.shiftKey && (active === first || active === this.element)) {
      event.preventDefault();
      last.focus();
    } else if (!event.shiftKey && active === last) {
      event.preventDefault();
      first.focus();
    }
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    if (event.target.closest(this.options.closeSelector)) {
      this.close('button');
    } else if (event.target === this.element && this.options.closeOnBackdrop) {
      this.close('backdrop');
    }
  }

  _emit(name, detail = {}, cancelable = false) {
    const event = new CustomEvent(name, { detail, cancelable, bubbles: true });
    return this.element.dispatchEvent(event);
  }
}
```

The file exports a single `Modal` class and a `ModalState` enum. Opening and closing are both guarded by cancelable "before" events, so application code can veto a transition, for example to block closing while a form has unsaved changes. Focus is moved into the dialog on open and returned to the triggering element on close, and a capture-phase keydown listener handles Escape and Tab while the modal is open.

modal-manager.js — Stacking, z-index, and queueing of multiple modals

/**
 * modal-manager.js
 *
 * Coordinates every modal instance on the page. A modal registers itself
 * with the manager instead of showing itself directly, which allows the
 * manager to decide whether it opens immediately, stacks above the current
 * modal, or waits in a queue.
 *
 * A modal is any object with this shape:
 *   { id: string, element: HTMLElement, show(): void, hide(): void,
 *     options: { mode?: 'stack' | 'queue', priority?: number } }
 */

const DEFAULT_OPTIONS = {
  baseZIndex: 1000,   // z-index of the first open modal
  maxStackDepth: 3,   // modals beyond this depth are queued
  inertAttribute: 'data-modal-inert',
};

export class ModalManager {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.options = { ...DEFAULT_OPTIONS, ...options };
    this.stack = [];   // open modals, last item is the topmost
    this.queue = [];   // modals waiting to open, ordered by priority
    this.returnFocus = new Map(); // modal id -> element focused before opening
    this._onKeydown = this._onKeydown.bind(this);
  }

  /**
   * Request that a modal be opened. Returns true if it opened immediately
   * and false if it was placed in the queue.
   */
  open(modal) {
    if (this._isOpen(modal) || this.queue.includes(modal)) {
      return this._isOpen(modal);
    }

    const mode = modal.options.mode || 'stack';
    const stackIsFull = this.stack.length >= this.options.maxStackDepth;

    // Queued modals only open once the stack is empty. Stacked modals open
    // on top of the current one unless the stack has reached its limit.
    if (stackIsFull || (mode === 'queue' && this.stack.length > 0)) {
      this._enqueue(modal);
      return false;
    }

    this._present(modal);
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Close a modal. When no id is given the topmost modal is closed.
   * The next queued modal opens once the stack is empty.
   */
  close(modal = this.top()) {
    if (!modal) return;

    const index = this.stack.indexOf(modal);
    if (index === -1) {
      // The modal may only be queued; remove it without showing anything.
      this.queue = this.queue.filter((item) => item !== modal);
      return;
    }

    this.stack.splice(index, 1);
    modal.hide();
    this._restoreFocus(modal);
    this._refreshLayers();

    if (this.stack.length === 0) {
      this._releaseQueue();
    }
    if (this.stack.length === 0) {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeydown);
    }
  }

  /** Return the topmost open modal, or undefined if none is open. */
  top() {
    return this.stack[this.stack.length - 1];
  }

  _isOpen(modal) {
    return this.stack.includes(modal);
  }

  _present(modal) {
    if (this.stack.length === 0) {
      document.addEventListener('keydown', this._onKeydown);
    }
    this.returnFocus.set(modal.id, document.activeElement);
    this.stack.push(modal);
    this._refreshLayers();
    modal.show();
  }

  /**
   * Insert into the queue keeping higher priority values first. Modals with
   * equal priority keep the order in which they were requested.
   */
  _enqueue(modal) {
    const priority = modal.options.priority || 0;
    const position = this.queue.findIndex(
      (queued) => (queued.options.priority || 0) < priority
    );
    if (position === -1) {
      this.queue.push(modal);
    } else {
      this.queue.splice(position, 0, modal);
    }
  }

  _releaseQueue() {
    const next = this.queue.shift();
    if (next) this._present(next);
  }

  /**
   * Assign z-index values by stack position and mark every modal below the
   * top as inert so that keyboard focus and assistive technology cannot
   * reach content that is visually covered.
   */
  _refreshLayers() {
    const { baseZIndex, inertAttribute } = this.options;
    const topModal = this.top();

    this.stack.forEach((modal, position) => {
      modal.element.style.zIndex = String(baseZIndex + position);
      const covered = modal !== topModal;
      modal.element.toggleAttribute(inertAttribute, covered);
      modal.element.toggleAttribute('inert', covered);
      modal.element.setAttribute('aria-hidden', covered ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
  }

  _restoreFocus(modal) {
    const previous = this.returnFocus.get(modal.id);
    this.returnFocus.delete(modal.id);
    if (previous && typeof previous.focus === 'function') previous.focus();
  }

  /** Escape closes only the topmost modal, never the ones beneath it. */
  _onKeydown(event) {
    if (event.key !== 'Escape') return;
    const modal = this.top();
    if (modal && modal.options.closeOnEscape !== false) {
      event.stopPropagation();
      this.close(modal);
    }
  }
}

// A shared instance is exported for the common case of one manager per page.
export const modalManager = new ModalManager();

confirm-dialog.js — Promise-based confirm and alert dialog helpers

```js
/**
 * confirm-dialog.js
 *
 * Promise-based replacements for window.confirm() and window.alert().
 * Each helper builds an accessible modal, moves focus into it, traps Tab,
 * and resolves a Promise when the user makes a choice. Focus returns to the
 * element that was active before the dialog opened.
 *
 * confirmDialog(options) -> Promise<boolean>
 * alertDialog(options)   -> Promise<void>
 */

let idCounter = 0;

const FOCUSABLE = [
  'button:not([disabled])',
  '[href]',
  'input:not([disabled])',
  'select:not([disabled])',
  'textarea:not([disabled])',
  '[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'
].join(',');

/** Create an element with a class name and optional text content. */
function el(tag, className, text) {
  const node = document.createElement(tag);
  if (className) node.className = className;
  if (text !== undefined) node.textContent = text;
  return node;
}

/**
 * Build and show a dialog. Shared by confirmDialog and alertDialog.
 *
 * @param {Object} config
 * @param {string} config.title
 * @param {string} config.message
 * @param {Array<{label: string, value: *, primary?: boolean, danger?: boolean}>} config.buttons
 * @param {*} config.dismissValue  Value resolved on Escape or backdrop click.
 * @param {HTMLElement} [config.container=document.body]
 * @returns {Promise<*>}
 */
function openDialog(config) {
  const container = config.container || document.body;
  const previouslyFocused = document.activeElement;
  idCounter += 1;
  const titleId = 'ui-dialog-title-' + idCounter;
  const messageId = 'ui-dialog-message-' + idCounter;

  const backdrop = el('div', 'ui-dialog-backdrop');
  const dialog = el('div', 'ui-dialog');
  dialog.setAttribute('role', 'alertdialog');
  dialog.setAttribute('aria-modal', 'true');
  dialog.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', titleId);
  dialog.setAttribute('aria-describedby', messageId);

  const title = el('h2', 'ui-dialog-title', config.title);
  title.id = titleId;
  const message = el('p', 'ui-dialog-message', config.message);
  message.id = messageId;
  const actions = el('div', 'ui-dialog-actions');

  dialog.append(title, message, actions);
  backdrop.append(dialog);

  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    let settled = false;

    function close(value) {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true;
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeydown, true);
      backdrop.remove();
      // Only restore focus if the original element is still in the page.
      if (previouslyFocused && document.contains(previouslyFocused)) {
        previouslyFocused.focus();
      }
      resolve(value);
    }

    function onKeydown(event) {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        event.preventDefault();
        close(config.dismissValue);
        return;
      }
      if (event.key !== 'Tab') return;

      // Keep keyboard focus inside the dialog.
      const items = Array.from(dialog.querySelectorAll(FOCUSABLE));
      if (items.length === 0) {
        event.preventDefault();
        return;
      }
      const first = items[0];
      const last = items[items.length - 1];
      if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
        event.preventDefault();
        last.focus();
      } else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
        event.preventDefault();
        first.focus();
      }
    }

    config.buttons.forEach((def) => {
      const button = el('button', 'ui-dialog-button', def.label);
      button.type = 'button';
      if (def.primary) button.classList.add('ui-dialog-button-primary');
      if (def.danger) button.classList.add('ui-dialog-button-danger');
      button.addEventListener('click', () => close(def.value));
      actions.append(button);
    });

    // A click on the backdrop itself (not the dialog) counts as dismissal.
    backdrop.addEventListener('mousedown', (event) => {
      if (event.target === backdrop) close(config.dismissValue);
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeydown, true);

    container.append(backdrop);

    // Prefer the primary button; fall back to the first button.
    const initial = actions.querySelector('.ui-dialog-button-primary') ||
      actions.querySelector('button');
    if (initial) initial.focus();
  });
}

/**
 * Ask the user to confirm an action.
 * Resolves true on confirmation, false on cancel, Escape, or backdrop click.
 * Set `danger: true` to style the confirm button as destructive; in that
 * case initial focus goes to the Cancel button.
 */
export function confirmDialog(options = {}) {
  const {
    title = 'Please confirm',
    message = '',
    confirmLabel = 'OK',
    cancelLabel = 'Cancel',
    danger = false,
    container
  } = options;

  return openDialog({
    title,
    message,
    container,
    dismissValue: false,
    buttons: [
      { label: cancelLabel, value: false, primary: danger },
      { label: confirmLabel, value: true, primary: !danger, danger }
    ]
  });
}

/**
 * Show a message with a single acknowledgement button.
 * Resolves with undefined once the dialog is closed.
 */
export function alertDialog(options = {}) {
  const { title = 'Notice', message = '', okLabel = 'OK', container } = options;

  return openDialog({
    title,
    message,
    container,
    dismissValue: undefined,
    buttons: [{ label: okLabel, value: undefined, primary: true }]
  });
}
```

/**
 * drawer.js
 *
 * A Drawer is a modal dialog that is anchored to the left or right edge of
 * the viewport. It reuses the Modal base class for open/close state, the
 * backdrop, and event dispatch, and adds side placement, a slide transition,
 * focus containment, and scroll locking.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   const drawer = new Drawer(document.querySelector('#filters'), {
 *     side: 'left',
 *     label: 'Filter results',
 *   });
 *   drawer.open();
 *
 * Events (dispatched on the drawer element):
 *   drawer:open    - fired when the drawer begins to open
 *   drawer:opened  - fired after the open transition has finished
 *   drawer:close   - fired when the drawer begins to close
 *   drawer:closed  - fired after the close transition has finished
 */
import { Modal } from './modal.js';
import { createFocusTrap } from './focus-trap.js';
import { lockScroll, unlockScroll } from './scroll-lock.js';

const SIDES = ['left', 'right'];

const DEFAULTS = {
  side: 'right',
  width: '24rem',
  label: '',
  closeOnBackdrop: true,
  closeOnEscape: true,
  returnFocus: true,
  transitionTimeout: 400,
};

export class Drawer extends Modal {
  /**
   * @param {HTMLElement} element  The panel element to turn into a drawer.
   * @param {object} [options]     Overrides for DEFAULTS.
   */
  constructor(element, options = {}) {
    const settings = { ...DEFAULTS, ...options };
    if (!SIDES.includes(settings.side)) {
      throw new RangeError(
        `Drawer: side must be one of ${SIDES.join(', ')}; received "${settings.side}".`
      );
    }
    super(element, settings);

    this.settings = settings;
    this.trap = null;
    this.previouslyFocused = null;
    this.pendingTimer = null;

    this.prepareElement();
  }

  /** Apply the attributes and classes that every drawer needs. */
  prepareElement() {
    const el = this.element;
    el.classList.add('ui-drawer', `ui-drawer--${this.settings.side}`);
    el.style.setProperty('--ui-drawer-width', this.settings.width);
    el.setAttribute('role', 'dialog');
    el.setAttribute('aria-modal', 'true');
    el.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    el.hidden = true;

    if (this.settings.label) {
      el.setAttribute('aria-label', this.settings.label);
    } else if (!el.hasAttribute('aria-labelledby')) {
      console.warn('Drawer: provide a label option or an aria-labelledby attribute.');
    }
  }

  /** Open the drawer. Calling open() on an open drawer has no effect. */
  open() {
    if (this.isOpen) return;
    this.previouslyFocused = document.activeElement;
    this.emit('drawer:open');

    this.element.hidden = false;
    this.element.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    lockScroll();
    this.showBackdrop();

    // Force a layout pass so the browser registers the starting position
    // before the open class is added and the transition begins.
    void this.element.offsetWidth;
    this.element.classList.add('ui-drawer--open');
    this.isOpen = true;

    this.trap = createFocusTrap(this.element, {
      initialFocus: this.element.querySelector('[autofocus]') || undefined,
      onEscape: this.settings.closeOnEscape ? () => this.close() : undefined,
    });
    this.trap.activate();

    this.afterTransition(() => this.emit('drawer:opened'));
  }

  /** Close the drawer and restore the page to its previous state. */
  close() {
    if (!this.isOpen) return;
    this.emit('drawer:close');

    this.isOpen = false;
    this.element.classList.remove('ui-drawer--open');
    this.element.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');

    if (this.trap) {
      this.trap.deactivate();
      this.trap = null;
    }

    this.afterTransition(() => {
      this.element.hidden = true;
      this.hideBackdrop();
      unlockScroll();
      this.restoreFocus();
      this.emit('drawer:closed');
    });
  }

  /** Called by the Modal base class when the backdrop is clicked. */
  handleBackdropClick() {
    if (this.settings.closeOnBackdrop) this.close();
  }

  /**
   * Run a callback once the CSS transition ends. A timer acts as a fallback
   * for cases where no transitionend event fires, such as when the user has
   * requested reduced motion and transitions are disabled.
   */
  afterTransition(callback) {
    clearTimeout(this.pendingTimer);
    let finished = false;

    const finish = () => {
      if (finished) return;
      finished = true;
      clearTimeout(this.pendingTimer);
      this.element.removeEventListener('transitionend', onEnd);
      callback();
    };
    const onEnd = (event) => {
      if (event.target === this.element) finish();
    };

    this.element.addEventListener('transitionend', onEnd);
    this.pendingTimer = setTimeout(finish, this.settings.transitionTimeout);
  }

  /** Return focus to the element that opened the drawer, if it still exists. */
  restoreFocus() {
    const target = this.previouslyFocused;
    this.previouslyFocused = null;
    if (this.settings.returnFocus && target && document.contains(target)) {
      target.focus();
    }
  }

  /** Remove listeners and generated classes. The element is left in the DOM. */
  destroy() {
    if (this.isOpen) this.close();
    clearTimeout(this.pendingTimer);
    this.element.classList.remove('ui-drawer', `ui-drawer--${this.settings.side}`);
    super.destroy();
  }
}

export default Drawer;

popover.js — Anchored floating content with positioning logic

/**
 * popover.js
 *
 * Anchored floating content for the form and UI library. A popover is a
 * non-modal panel attached to a trigger element. It is positioned relative to
 * the trigger, flips to the opposite side when it would leave the viewport,
 * and closes on Escape or on an outside click.
 *
 * Accessibility notes:
 *  - The trigger receives aria-expanded and aria-controls.
 *  - The panel receives role="dialog" and is hidden with the `hidden` attribute.
 *  - Focus moves into the panel on open and returns to the trigger on close.
 */

const OPPOSITE = { top: 'bottom', bottom: 'top', left: 'right', right: 'left' };
const DEFAULTS = { placement: 'bottom', offset: 8, margin: 4, closeOnOutside: true };

let idCounter = 0;

/**
 * Compute the top/left coordinates of the panel for a given placement.
 * All rectangles are in viewport coordinates.
 */
function computeCoords(anchor, panel, placement, offset) {
  const centerX = anchor.left + anchor.width / 2 - panel.width / 2;
  const centerY = anchor.top + anchor.height / 2 - panel.height / 2;

  switch (placement) {
    case 'top':
      return { top: anchor.top - panel.height - offset, left: centerX };
    case 'left':
      return { top: centerY, left: anchor.left - panel.width - offset };
    case 'right':
      return { top: centerY, left: anchor.right + offset };
    case 'bottom':
    default:
      return { top: anchor.bottom + offset, left: centerX };
  }
}

/** Return true when the panel at these coordinates fits inside the viewport. */
function fitsViewport(coords, panel, margin) {
  const viewW = document.documentElement.clientWidth;
  const viewH = document.documentElement.clientHeight;
  return (
    coords.top >= margin &&
    coords.left >= margin &&
    coords.top + panel.height <= viewH - margin &&
    coords.left + panel.width <= viewW - margin
  );
}

/** Clamp a value between a lower and an upper bound. */
function clamp(value, min, max) {
  return Math.max(min, Math.min(value, max));
}

export class Popover {
  /**
   * @param {HTMLElement} trigger  Element that toggles the popover.
   * @param {HTMLElement} panel    Element containing the floating content.
   * @param {object} [options]     Overrides for DEFAULTS.
   */
  constructor(trigger, panel, options = {}) {
    this.trigger = trigger;
    this.panel = panel;
    this.options = { ...DEFAULTS, ...options };
    this.isOpen = false;

    if (!panel.id) panel.id = `ui-popover-${++idCounter}`;
    panel.setAttribute('role', 'dialog');
    panel.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
    panel.hidden = true;
    panel.style.position = 'fixed';

    trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    trigger.setAttribute('aria-controls', panel.id);

    this._onToggle = () => this.toggle();
    this._onKeydown = (event) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') this.close();
    };
    this._onDocumentClick = (event) => {
      const inside = this.panel.contains(event.target) || this.trigger.contains(event.target);
      if (!inside && this.options.closeOnOutside) this.close();
    };
    this._onReposition = () => this.position();

    trigger.addEventListener('click', this._onToggle);
  }

  /** Place the panel next to the trigger, flipping or clamping as needed. */
  position() {
    const { placement, offset, margin } = this.options;
    const anchor = this.trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
    const size = this.panel.getBoundingClientRect();

    let chosen = placement;
    let coords = computeCoords(anchor, size, chosen, offset);

    if (!fitsViewport(coords, size, margin)) {
      const flipped = OPPOSITE[placement];
      const alt = computeCoords(anchor, size, flipped, offset);
      if (fitsViewport(alt, size, margin)) {
        chosen = flipped;
        coords = alt;
      }
    }

    // As a last resort keep the panel fully on screen along both axes.
    const maxLeft = document.documentElement.clientWidth - size.width - margin;
    const maxTop = document.documentElement.clientHeight - size.height - margin;
    this.panel.style.left = `${clamp(coords.left, margin, maxLeft)}px`;
    this.panel.style.top = `${clamp(coords.top, margin, maxTop)}px`;
    this.panel.dataset.placement = chosen;
  }

  open() {
    if (this.isOpen) return;
    this.isOpen = true;
    this.panel.hidden = false;
    this.trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    this.position();
    this.panel.focus();

    document.addEventListener('keydown', this._onKeydown);
    document.addEventListener('click', this._onDocumentClick);
    window.addEventListener('resize', this._onReposition);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', this._onReposition, true);
    this.panel.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('popover:open', { bubbles: true }));
  }

  close() {
    if (!this.isOpen) return;
    this.isOpen = false;
    this.panel.hidden = true;
    this.trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    this.trigger.focus();

    document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeydown);
    document.removeEventListener('click', this._onDocumentClick);
    window.removeEventListener('resize', this._onReposition);
    window.removeEventListener('scroll', this._onReposition, true);
    this.panel.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('popover:close', { bubbles: true }));
  }

  toggle() {
    this.isOpen ? this.close() : this.open();
  }

  /** Remove all listeners and restore the trigger to its initial state. */
  destroy() {
    this.close();
    this.trigger.removeEventListener('click', this._onToggle);
    this.trigger.removeAttribute('aria-expanded');
    this.trigger.removeAttribute('aria-controls');
  }
}

tooltip.js — Hover and focus tooltips with accessible descriptions

```js
/**
 * tooltip.js
 *
 * Attaches a short text description to an element. The description appears
 * on pointer hover and on keyboard focus, and is linked to the trigger with
 * aria-describedby so assistive technology announces it with the element.
 *
 * Behaviour follows the WAI-ARIA tooltip pattern:
 *   - Escape dismisses the tooltip without moving focus.
 *   - The pointer can move onto the tooltip without closing it.
 *   - The tooltip stays visible until hover or focus leaves.
 */

const DEFAULT_OPTIONS = {
  showDelay: 300,   // milliseconds before the tooltip appears on hover
  hideDelay: 100,   // milliseconds of grace so the pointer can cross the gap
  placement: 'top', // 'top' or 'bottom'
  offset: 8,        // pixels between trigger and tooltip
};

let idCounter = 0;

/** Return a document-unique id for a tooltip element. */
function nextId() {
  idCounter += 1;
  return `ui-tooltip-${idCounter}`;
}

export class Tooltip {
  /**
   * @param {HTMLElement} trigger  Element that receives the description.
   * @param {string} content       Plain text shown in the tooltip.
   * @param {object} [options]     Overrides for DEFAULT_OPTIONS.
   */
  constructor(trigger, content, options = {}) {
    this.trigger = trigger;
    this.options = { ...DEFAULT_OPTIONS, ...options };
    this.showTimer = null;
    this.hideTimer = null;
    this.visible = false;

    this.el = document.createElement('div');
    this.el.id = nextId();
    this.el.setAttribute('role', 'tooltip');
    this.el.className = 'ui-tooltip';
    this.el.hidden = true;
    this.el.textContent = content;
    document.body.appendChild(this.el);

    // Preserve any description the author already provided.
    const existing = trigger.getAttribute('aria-describedby');
    this.previousDescribedBy = existing;
    trigger.setAttribute(
      'aria-describedby',
      existing ? `${existing} ${this.el.id}` : this.el.id
    );

    // Bound handlers so they can be removed in destroy().
    this.onEnter = () => this.scheduleShow();
    this.onLeave = () => this.scheduleHide();
    this.onFocus = () => this.show();
    this.onBlur = () => this.hide();
    this.onKeydown = (event) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape' && this.visible) {
        this.hide();
      }
    };

    trigger.addEventListener('mouseenter', this.onEnter);
    trigger.addEventListener('mouseleave', this.onLeave);
    trigger.addEventListener('focus', this.onFocus);
    trigger.addEventListener('blur', this.onBlur);
    trigger.addEventListener('keydown', this.onKeydown);

    // Keep the tooltip open while the pointer is over it.
    this.el.addEventListener('mouseenter', this.onEnter);
    this.el.addEventListener('mouseleave', this.onLeave);
  }

  /** Start the show delay, cancelling any pending hide. */
  scheduleShow() {
    clearTimeout(this.hideTimer);
    if (this.visible) return;
    clearTimeout(this.showTimer);
    this.showTimer = setTimeout(() => this.show(), this.options.showDelay);
  }

  /** Start the hide delay, cancelling any pending show. */
  scheduleHide() {
    clearTimeout(this.showTimer);
    clearTimeout(this.hideTimer);
    this.hideTimer = setTimeout(() => this.hide(), this.options.hideDelay);
  }

  /** Display the tooltip immediately and position it. */
  show() {
    clearTimeout(this.showTimer);
    clearTimeout(this.hideTimer);
    this.el.hidden = false;
    this.visible = true;
    this.position();
  }

  /** Hide the tooltip immediately. */
  hide() {
    clearTimeout(this.showTimer);
    clearTimeout(this.hideTimer);
    this.el.hidden = true;
    this.visible = false;
  }

  /** Replace the tooltip text; the description updates for screen readers. */
  setContent(content) {
    this.el.textContent = content;
    if (this.visible) this.position();
  }

  /** Place the tooltip next to the trigger and keep it inside the viewport. */
  position() {
    const anchor = this.trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
    const tip = this.el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const { offset } = this.options;

    let placement = this.options.placement;
    // Flip to the bottom when there is no room above the trigger.
    if (placement === 'top' && anchor.top < tip.height + offset) {
      placement = 'bottom';
    }

    const top = placement === 'top'
      ? anchor.top - tip.height - offset
      : anchor.bottom + offset;

    const centered = anchor.left + (anchor.width - tip.width) / 2;
    const maxLeft = document.documentElement.clientWidth - tip.width;
    const left = Math.max(0, Math.min(centered, maxLeft));

    this.el.style.position = 'fixed';
    this.el.style.top = `${top}px`;
    this.el.style.left = `${left}px`;
    this.el.dataset.placement = placement;
  }

  /** Remove listeners and DOM nodes and restore the trigger's attributes. */
  destroy() {
    this.hide();
    this.trigger.removeEventListener('mouseenter', this.onEnter);
    this.trigger.removeEventListener('mouseleave', this.onLeave);
    this.trigger.removeEventListener('focus', this.onFocus);
    this.trigger.removeEventListener('blur', this.onBlur);
    this.trigger.removeEventListener('keydown', this.onKeydown);

    if (this.previousDescribedBy) {
      this.trigger.setAttribute('aria-describedby', this.previousDescribedBy);
    } else {
      this.trigger.removeAttribute('aria-describedby');
    }
    this.el.remove();
  }
}

/**
 * Create tooltips for every element matching the selector that carries a
 * data-tooltip attribute. Returns the created instances.
 */
export function initTooltips(root = document, selector = '[data-tooltip]') {
  return Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(selector)).map(
    (node) => new Tooltip(node, node.dataset.tooltip)
  );
}
```

toast.js — Transient notification messages with auto-dismiss

```js
/**
 * toast.js
 *
 * Transient notification messages that dismiss themselves after a delay.
 * Toasts are announced to assistive technology through a live region.
 * The auto-dismiss timer pauses while the pointer or keyboard focus is
 * inside a toast, so users have time to read and interact with it.
 */

const DEFAULTS = {
  duration: 5000,      // milliseconds before auto-dismiss; 0 keeps the toast open
  type: 'info',        // 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error'
  maxVisible: 4,       // oldest toast is removed when this limit is exceeded
  dismissLabel: 'Dismiss notification',
};

export class ToastManager {
  /**
   * @param {Object} [options] Overrides for DEFAULTS.
   * @param {HTMLElement} [options.root] Element the container is appended to.
   */
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.options = { ...DEFAULTS, ...options };
    this.toasts = new Set();
    this.container = this._createContainer(options.root || document.body);
  }

  /** Build the region that holds every toast. */
  _createContainer(root) {
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = 'toast-container';
    // Polite announcements avoid interrupting the user's current task.
    el.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
    el.setAttribute('aria-relevant', 'additions');
    root.appendChild(el);
    return el;
  }

  /**
   * Display a toast.
   * @param {string} message Plain text; it is never inserted as HTML.
   * @param {Object} [opts] Per-toast overrides of the manager options.
   * @returns {{ dismiss: Function, element: HTMLElement }}
   */
  show(message, opts = {}) {
    const config = { ...this.options, ...opts };
    const element = this._render(message, config);
    const toast = { element, timer: null, config };

    this.toasts.add(toast);
    this.container.appendChild(element);
    this._enforceLimit();
    this._bindInteractions(toast);
    this._startTimer(toast);

    return { dismiss: () => this.dismiss(toast), element };
  }

  /** Create the DOM for a single toast. */
  _render(message, config) {
    const element = document.createElement('div');
    element.className = `toast toast--${config.type}`;
    // Errors are announced immediately; other types wait for a pause.
    element.setAttribute('role', config.type === 'error' ? 'alert' : 'status');

    const text = document.createElement('span');
    text.className = 'toast__message';
    text.textContent = message;

    const close = document.createElement('button');
    close.type = 'button';
    close.className = 'toast__close';
    close.setAttribute('aria-label', config.dismissLabel);
    close.textContent = '\u00d7';

    element.append(text, close);
    return element;
  }

  /** Wire up close button, hover, focus and Escape handling. */
  _bindInteractions(toast) {
    const { element } = toast;
    const pause = () => this._clearTimer(toast);
    const resume = () => this._startTimer(toast);

    element.querySelector('.toast__close')
      .addEventListener('click', () => this.dismiss(toast));
    element.addEventListener('mouseenter', pause);
    element.addEventListener('mouseleave', resume);
    element.addEventListener('focusin', pause);
    element.addEventListener('focusout', resume);
    element.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') this.dismiss(toast);
    });
  }

  /** Start (or restart) the countdown. A duration of 0 means persistent. */
  _startTimer(toast) {
    this._clearTimer(toast);
    if (!toast.config.duration) return;
    toast.timer = setTimeout(() => this.dismiss(toast), toast.config.duration);
  }

  _clearTimer(toast) {
    clearTimeout(toast.timer);
    toast.timer = null;
  }

  /** Remove the oldest toasts while the visible limit is exceeded. */
  _enforceLimit() {
    for (const toast of this.toasts) {
      if (this.toasts.size <= this.options.maxVisible) break;
      this.dismiss(toast);
    }
  }

  /** Remove a toast and release its timer. Safe to call more than once. */
  dismiss(toast) {
    if (!this.toasts.has(toast)) return;
    this._clearTimer(toast);
    this.toasts.delete(toast);
    toast.element.remove();
  }

  /** Remove every toast, for example on route changes. */
  clear() {
    [...this.toasts].forEach((toast) => this.dismiss(toast));
  }
}

// Shared instance for applications that need only one toast region.
export const toast = new ToastManager();
```

Design notes

The manager owns a single live region, created once, and appends each toast to it. Screen readers announce additions to a region that already exists in the document more reliably than they announce a region inserted together with its content. Error toasts use `role="alert"` so they are announced right away. Other types use `role="status"`.

Messages are set through `textContent`, so user-supplied strings cannot inject markup.

The timer pauses on hover and on focus, and a fresh full countdown starts when the pointer or focus leaves. This is simpler than tracking remaining time, and it gives readers a complete interval after they finish interacting. Setting `duration` to `0` keeps a toast open until the user dismisses it with the close button or the Escape key. Use that setting for messages that require a decision.

`dismiss` is idempotent. The timer callback, the close button and `clear()` can all reach the same toast, and the `Set` membership check makes repeated calls harmless.

tabs.js — Tab list and panel component with activation modes

/**
 * tabs.js
 *
 * Accessible tab list and panel component.
 *
 * Expected markup:
 *   <div data-tabs>
 *     <div role="tablist" aria-label="Account">
 *       <button role="tab" aria-controls="panel-a">Profile</button>
 *       <button role="tab" aria-controls="panel-b">Security</button>
 *     </div>
 *     <div role="tabpanel" id="panel-a">...</div>
 *     <div role="tabpanel" id="panel-b">...</div>
 *   </div>
 *
 * Activation modes:
 *   "automatic" - moving focus with the arrow keys also selects the tab.
 *   "manual"    - arrow keys only move focus; Enter or Space selects.
 *
 * Keyboard support follows the WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices tabs pattern.
 */

const DEFAULTS = {
  activation: "automatic",
  orientation: "horizontal",
  initialIndex: 0,
  onChange: null,
};

let idCounter = 0;

export class Tabs {
  /**
   * @param {HTMLElement} root - Element containing the tablist and panels.
   * @param {Object} [options]
   * @param {"automatic"|"manual"} [options.activation]
   * @param {"horizontal"|"vertical"} [options.orientation]
   * @param {number} [options.initialIndex] - Tab selected on startup.
   * @param {Function} [options.onChange] - Called with (index, tab, panel).
   */
  constructor(root, options = {}) {
    this.root = root;
    this.options = { ...DEFAULTS, ...options };
    this.list = root.querySelector('[role="tablist"]');
    this.tabs = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]'));
    this.panels = this.tabs.map((tab) =>
      root.querySelector("#" + tab.getAttribute("aria-controls"))
    );
    this.selectedIndex = -1;

    this._onClick = this._onClick.bind(this);
    this._onKeydown = this._onKeydown.bind(this);
    this._setup();
  }

  _setup() {
    idCounter += 1;
    this.list.setAttribute("aria-orientation", this.options.orientation);

    this.tabs.forEach((tab, i) => {
      if (!tab.id) tab.id = `tabs-${idCounter}-tab-${i}`;
      this.panels[i].setAttribute("aria-labelledby", tab.id);
      tab.addEventListener("click", this._onClick);
      tab.addEventListener("keydown", this._onKeydown);
    });

    this.select(this.options.initialIndex, { focus: false });
  }

  /**
   * Select a tab, show its panel and hide the others.
   * Only the selected tab stays in the page tab order (roving tabindex).
   */
  select(index, { focus = true } = {}) {
    if (index < 0 || index >= this.tabs.length) return;
    const changed = index !== this.selectedIndex;

    this.tabs.forEach((tab, i) => {
      const active = i === index;
      tab.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(active));
      tab.tabIndex = active ? 0 : -1;
      this.panels[i].hidden = !active;
    });

    this.selectedIndex = index;
    if (focus) this.tabs[index].focus();

    if (changed && typeof this.options.onChange === "function") {
      this.options.onChange(index, this.tabs[index], this.panels[index]);
    }
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    this.select(this.tabs.indexOf(event.currentTarget));
  }

  _onKeydown(event) {
    const current = this.tabs.indexOf(event.currentTarget);
    const vertical = this.options.orientation === "vertical";
    const prevKey = vertical ? "ArrowUp" : "ArrowLeft";
    const nextKey = vertical ? "ArrowDown" : "ArrowRight";
    const last = this.tabs.length - 1;
    let target = null;

    switch (event.key) {
      case prevKey:
        target = current === 0 ? last : current - 1;
        break;
      case nextKey:
        target = current === last ? 0 : current + 1;
        break;
      case "Home":
        target = 0;
        break;
      case "End":
        target = last;
        break;
      case "Enter":
      case " ":
        // In manual mode these keys perform the selection.
        event.preventDefault();
        this.select(current);
        return;
      default:
        return;
    }

    event.preventDefault();
    if (this.options.activation === "automatic") {
      this.select(target);
    } else {
      this._moveFocus(target);
    }
  }

  /** Move focus without changing the selected tab (manual mode). */
  _moveFocus(index) {
    this.tabs.forEach((tab, i) => {
      tab.tabIndex = i === index ? 0 : -1;
    });
    this.tabs[index].focus();
  }

  /** Remove listeners so the instance can be discarded safely. */
  destroy() {
    this.tabs.forEach((tab) => {
      tab.removeEventListener("click", this._onClick);
      tab.removeEventListener("keydown", this._onKeydown);
    });
  }
}

/** Initialise every element marked with data-tabs inside a container. */
export function initTabs(container = document, options = {}) {
  return Array.from(container.querySelectorAll("[data-tabs]")).map(
    (el) => new Tabs(el, { ...options, ...readDataOptions(el) })
  );
}

function readDataOptions(el) {
  const out = {};
  if (el.dataset.activation) out.activation = el.dataset.activation;
  if (el.dataset.orientation) out.orientation = el.dataset.orientation;
  return out;
}

accordion.js — Collapsible sections with single or multiple expansion

```js
/**
 * accordion.js
 *
 * Collapsible sections with single or multiple expansion.
 *
 * Expected markup:
 *   <div id="faq">
 *     <h3 data-accordion-header><button>Question</button></h3>
 *     <div data-accordion-panel>Answer</div>
 *     ...
 *   </div>
 *
 * Headers and panels are paired by document order. Each header must
 * contain, or be, a focusable control (normally a button) that receives
 * the click and keyboard handling.
 */

const DEFAULTS = {
  multiple: false,          // allow several panels open at once
  collapsible: true,        // in single mode, allow the open panel to close
  headerSelector: '[data-accordion-header]',
  panelSelector: '[data-accordion-panel]',
  openClass: 'is-open',
  initiallyOpen: []         // indexes of panels open on creation
};

let instanceCount = 0;

export class Accordion {
  /**
   * @param {HTMLElement} root     Element containing headers and panels.
   * @param {object}      options  Overrides for DEFAULTS.
   */
  constructor(root, options = {}) {
    if (!(root instanceof HTMLElement)) {
      throw new TypeError('Accordion: root must be an HTMLElement');
    }
    this.root = root;
    this.options = { ...DEFAULTS, ...options };
    this.items = [];
    this.id = `accordion-${instanceCount++}`;
    this._onClick = this._onClick.bind(this);
    this._onKeydown = this._onKeydown.bind(this);
    this._init();
  }

  _init() {
    const { headerSelector, panelSelector, initiallyOpen, multiple } = this.options;
    const headers = this.root.querySelectorAll(headerSelector);
    const panels = this.root.querySelectorAll(panelSelector);

    if (headers.length !== panels.length) {
      throw new Error('Accordion: header and panel counts do not match');
    }

    headers.forEach((header, index) => {
      const trigger = header.matches('button') ? header : header.querySelector('button');
      if (!trigger) throw new Error(`Accordion: header ${index} has no button`);

      const panel = panels[index];
      const triggerId = `${this.id}-header-${index}`;
      const panelId = `${this.id}-panel-${index}`;

      trigger.id = triggerId;
      trigger.setAttribute('aria-controls', panelId);
      panel.id = panelId;
      panel.setAttribute('role', 'region');
      panel.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', triggerId);

      this.items.push({ header, trigger, panel });
      this._setState(index, false);
    });

    // In single mode only the first requested panel is honoured.
    const startOpen = multiple ? initiallyOpen : initiallyOpen.slice(0, 1);
    startOpen.forEach((index) => this.open(index, { silent: true }));

    this.root.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
    this.root.addEventListener('keydown', this._onKeydown);
  }

  /** Apply the visual and ARIA state for one item without side effects. */
  _setState(index, expanded) {
    const { trigger, panel, header } = this.items[index];
    trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(expanded));
    panel.hidden = !expanded;
    header.classList.toggle(this.options.openClass, expanded);
  }

  _indexOf(target) {
    return this.items.findIndex((item) => item.trigger.contains(target));
  }

  isOpen(index) {
    return this.items[index]?.trigger.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
  }

  /** Open a panel, closing the others when multiple is false. */
  open(index, { silent = false } = {}) {
    if (!this.items[index] || this.isOpen(index)) return;
    if (!this.options.multiple) {
      this.items.forEach((_, i) => {
        if (i !== index && this.isOpen(i)) this._change(i, false, silent);
      });
    }
    this._change(index, true, silent);
  }

  /** Close a panel. Ignored for the open panel when collapsible is false. */
  close(index, { silent = false } = {}) {
    if (!this.items[index] || !this.isOpen(index)) return;
    if (!this.options.multiple && !this.options.collapsible) return;
    this._change(index, false, silent);
  }

  toggle(index) {
    if (this.isOpen(index)) this.close(index);
    else this.open(index);
  }

  _change(index, expanded, silent) {
    this._setState(index, expanded);
    if (silent) return;
    this.root.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('accordion:toggle', {
      bubbles: true,
      detail: { index, expanded, panel: this.items[index].panel }
    }));
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const index = this._indexOf(event.target);
    if (index !== -1) this.toggle(index);
  }

  /** Arrow keys, Home and End move focus between headers. */
  _onKeydown(event) {
    const current = this._indexOf(event.target);
    if (current === -1) return;

    const last = this.items.length - 1;
    let next;
    switch (event.key) {
      case 'ArrowDown': next = current === last ? 0 : current + 1; break;
      case 'ArrowUp':   next = current === 0 ? last : current - 1; break;
      case 'Home':      next = 0; break;
      case 'End':       next = last; break;
      default: return;
    }
    event.preventDefault();
    this.items[next].trigger.focus();
  }

  /** Remove listeners and generated attributes. Panels are left visible. */
  destroy() {
    this.root.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
    this.root.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeydown);
    this.items.forEach(({ trigger, panel, header }) => {
      trigger.removeAttribute('aria-expanded');
      trigger.removeAttribute('aria-controls');
      panel.removeAttribute('role');
      panel.removeAttribute('aria-labelledby');
      panel.hidden = false;
      header.classList.remove(this.options.openClass);
    });
    this.items = [];
  }
}
```

Design notes: the accordion keeps its state only in the DOM, through `aria-expanded` and the `hidden` attribute. This means assistive technology and the script always agree, and there is no separate state object to fall out of sync. Initial openings and programmatic changes can pass `silent: true` to avoid emitting `accordion:toggle`, which is useful when restoring saved state.

dropdown-menu.js — Action menu with keyboard navigation and typeahead

/**
 * dropdown-menu.js
 *
 * Action menu that follows the WAI-ARIA menu button pattern.
 * A trigger button opens a list of role="menuitem" elements.
 * Focus moves inside the menu with a roving tabindex, so only the
 * active item is reachable by Tab at any time.
 *
 * Markup expected:
 *   <button id="actions-btn">Actions</button>
 *   <ul id="actions-menu" role="menu" hidden>
 *     <li role="menuitem">Rename</li>
 *     <li role="menuitem" aria-disabled="true">Delete</li>
 *   </ul>
 *
 * Events (dispatched on the menu element):
 *   "menu:open", "menu:close", "menu:select" (detail: { item })
 */

const TYPEAHEAD_RESET_MS = 500;
const ITEM_SELECTOR = '[role="menuitem"]:not([aria-disabled="true"])';

export class DropdownMenu {
  /**
   * @param {HTMLElement} button  Trigger element.
   * @param {HTMLElement} menu    Container holding the menu items.
   * @param {object} [options]
   * @param {boolean} [options.wrap=true]  Wrap focus at either end.
   */
  constructor(button, menu, options = {}) {
    this.button = button;
    this.menu = menu;
    this.wrap = options.wrap !== false;
    this.buffer = '';
    this.bufferTimer = null;

    button.setAttribute('aria-haspopup', 'menu');
    button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    if (menu.id) button.setAttribute('aria-controls', menu.id);

    this.onButtonClick = () => (this.isOpen() ? this.close() : this.open());
    this.onButtonKey = this.onButtonKey.bind(this);
    this.onMenuKey = this.onMenuKey.bind(this);
    this.onMenuClick = this.onMenuClick.bind(this);
    this.onDocumentPointer = this.onDocumentPointer.bind(this);

    button.addEventListener('click', this.onButtonClick);
    button.addEventListener('keydown', this.onButtonKey);
    menu.addEventListener('keydown', this.onMenuKey);
    menu.addEventListener('click', this.onMenuClick);
  }

  /** Enabled items in document order. Re-queried so dynamic menus work. */
  get items() {
    return Array.from(this.menu.querySelectorAll(ITEM_SELECTOR));
  }

  isOpen() {
    return !this.menu.hidden;
  }

  /** Show the menu and focus an item (first by default, last on request). */
  open(focusLast = false) {
    if (this.isOpen()) return;
    this.menu.hidden = false;
    this.button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', this.onDocumentPointer);
    const items = this.items;
    if (items.length) this.focusItem(focusLast ? items[items.length - 1] : items[0]);
    this.menu.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('menu:open'));
  }

  /** Hide the menu; optionally return focus to the trigger. */
  close(returnFocus = true) {
    if (!this.isOpen()) return;
    this.menu.hidden = true;
    this.button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', this.onDocumentPointer);
    this.resetBuffer();
    if (returnFocus) this.button.focus();
    this.menu.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('menu:close'));
  }

  /** Roving tabindex: only the focused item is tabbable. */
  focusItem(target) {
    this.items.forEach((item) => item.setAttribute('tabindex', item === target ? '0' : '-1'));
    target.focus();
  }

  /** Move focus relative to the current item, honouring the wrap option. */
  moveFocus(step) {
    const items = this.items;
    if (!items.length) return;
    const current = items.indexOf(document.activeElement);
    let next = current + step;
    if (this.wrap) {
      next = (next + items.length) % items.length;
    } else {
      next = Math.min(Math.max(next, 0), items.length - 1);
    }
    this.focusItem(items[next]);
  }

  onButtonKey(event) {
    if (event.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.open(false);
    } else if (event.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.open(true);
    }
  }

  onMenuKey(event) {
    const items = this.items;
    switch (event.key) {
      case 'ArrowDown': this.moveFocus(1); break;
      case 'ArrowUp': this.moveFocus(-1); break;
      case 'Home': if (items.length) this.focusItem(items[0]); break;
      case 'End': if (items.length) this.focusItem(items[items.length - 1]); break;
      case 'Escape': this.close(); break;
      case 'Tab': this.close(false); return; // let focus move on naturally
      case 'Enter':
      case ' ': this.select(document.activeElement); break;
      default:
        // Printable single characters drive typeahead; ignore shortcuts.
        if (event.key.length === 1 && !event.ctrlKey && !event.metaKey && !event.altKey) {
          this.typeahead(event.key);
          return;
        }
        return;
    }
    event.preventDefault();
  }

  /** Accumulate typed characters and focus the first matching item. */
  typeahead(char) {
    clearTimeout(this.bufferTimer);
    this.buffer += char.toLowerCase();
    this.bufferTimer = setTimeout(() => this.resetBuffer(), TYPEAHEAD_RESET_MS);

    const items = this.items;
    const start = items.indexOf(document.activeElement);
    // Repeating one letter cycles through items starting with it.
    const repeated = this.buffer.split('').every((c) => c === this.buffer[0]);
    const needle = repeated ? this.buffer[0] : this.buffer;
    const ordered = items.slice(start + 1).concat(items.slice(0, start + 1));
    const match = ordered.find((item) =>
      item.textContent.trim().toLowerCase().startsWith(needle));
    if (match) this.focusItem(match);
  }

  resetBuffer() {
    this.buffer = '';
    clearTimeout(this.bufferTimer);
  }

  onMenuClick(event) {
    const item = event.target.closest(ITEM_SELECTOR);
    if (item && this.menu.contains(item)) this.select(item);
  }

  select(item) {
    if (!item || !item.matches(ITEM_SELECTOR)) return;
    this.menu.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('menu:select', { detail: { item } }));
    this.close();
  }

  onDocumentPointer(event) {
    if (!this.menu.contains(event.target) && !this.button.contains(event.target)) {
      this.close(false);
    }
  }

  /** Remove all listeners added by this instance. */
  destroy() {
    this.close(false);
    this.button.removeEventListener('click', this.onButtonClick);
    this.button.removeEventListener('keydown', this.onButtonKey);
    this.menu.removeEventListener('keydown', this.onMenuKey);
    this.menu.removeEventListener('click', this.onMenuClick);
  }
}

focus-trap.js — Keeps keyboard focus inside a container such as a modal

```js
/**
 * focus-trap.js
 *
 * Keeps keyboard focus inside a container element (for example a modal
 * dialog) while the trap is active. Tab and Shift+Tab wrap between the
 * first and last focusable elements, and focus that escapes by other
 * means (mouse click, script, assistive technology) is pulled back in.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   const trap = createFocusTrap(dialogEl, { escapeDeactivates: true });
 *   trap.activate();
 *   // later
 *   trap.deactivate();
 */

const FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR = [
  'a[href]',
  'area[href]',
  'button:not([disabled])',
  'input:not([disabled]):not([type="hidden"])',
  'select:not([disabled])',
  'textarea:not([disabled])',
  'iframe',
  '[contenteditable="true"]',
  '[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'
].join(',');

/**
 * An element is considered visible when it takes up layout space and is
 * not hidden through the `visibility` property.
 */
function isVisible(el) {
  if (el.hidden || el.closest('[hidden]')) return false;
  const style = window.getComputedStyle(el);
  if (style.visibility === 'hidden' || style.display === 'none') return false;
  return el.getClientRects().length > 0;
}

/** Returns the focusable, visible descendants of `container` in DOM order. */
function getFocusableElements(container) {
  return Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR)).filter(isVisible);
}

/**
 * @param {HTMLElement} container  Element that should contain focus.
 * @param {Object} [options]
 * @param {HTMLElement|string|Function} [options.initialFocus]
 *        Element, selector, or function returning an element to focus first.
 *        Defaults to the first focusable element, or the container itself.
 * @param {boolean} [options.returnFocusOnDeactivate=true]
 *        Restore focus to the previously focused element on deactivate.
 * @param {boolean} [options.escapeDeactivates=false]
 *        Deactivate the trap when the Escape key is pressed.
 * @param {Function} [options.onDeactivate]
 *        Called after the trap has been deactivated.
 * @returns {{activate: Function, deactivate: Function, pause: Function,
 *            unpause: Function, update: Function}}
 */
export function createFocusTrap(container, options = {}) {
  const settings = {
    initialFocus: null,
    returnFocusOnDeactivate: true,
    escapeDeactivates: false,
    onDeactivate: null,
    ...options
  };

  let active = false;
  let paused = false;
  let previouslyFocused = null;
  let focusable = [];

  /** Recalculate the list of focusable elements. Call after DOM changes. */
  function update() {
    focusable = getFocusableElements(container);
  }

  function resolveInitialFocus() {
    const target = settings.initialFocus;
    let el = typeof target === 'function' ? target() : target;
    if (typeof el === 'string') el = container.querySelector(el);
    if (el) return el;
    return focusable.length > 0 ? focusable[0] : container;
  }

  function focusElement(el) {
    // The container needs a tabindex to receive focus when it has no
    // focusable children.
    if (el === container && !container.hasAttribute('tabindex')) {
      container.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
    }
    el.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }

  function handleKeydown(event) {
    if (!active || paused) return;

    if (event.key === 'Escape' && settings.escapeDeactivates) {
      event.preventDefault();
      deactivate();
      return;
    }

    if (event.key !== 'Tab') return;

    update();
    if (focusable.length === 0) {
      event.preventDefault();
      focusElement(container);
      return;
    }

    const first = focusable[0];
    const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];
    const current = document.activeElement;

    if (event.shiftKey && (current === first || current === container)) {
      event.preventDefault();
      focusElement(last);
    } else if (!event.shiftKey && current === last) {
      event.preventDefault();
      focusElement(first);
    } else if (!container.contains(current)) {
      event.preventDefault();
      focusElement(first);
    }
  }

  // Focus that lands outside the container is returned to it.
  function handleFocusIn(event) {
    if (!active || paused) return;
    if (container.contains(event.target)) return;
    update();
    focusElement(focusable.length > 0 ? focusable[0] : container);
  }

  function activate() {
    if (active) return;
    previouslyFocused = document.activeElement;
    update();
    active = true;
    paused = false;
    document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown, true);
    document.addEventListener('focusin', handleFocusIn, true);
    focusElement(resolveInitialFocus());
  }

  function deactivate() {
    if (!active) return;
    active = false;
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown, true);
    document.removeEventListener('focusin', handleFocusIn, true);

    if (settings.returnFocusOnDeactivate && previouslyFocused &&
        typeof previouslyFocused.focus === 'function') {
      previouslyFocused.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
    previouslyFocused = null;
    if (typeof settings.onDeactivate === 'function') settings.onDeactivate();
  }

  // Pausing lets a nested trap (such as a confirmation dialog) take over.
  function pause() { paused = true; }
  function unpause() { paused = false; update(); }

  return { activate, deactivate, pause, unpause, update };
}
```
